6479236344.name: Penloop
6479236344.description: Penloop isn’t just a tool for storing information—it’s a space for thinking, creating, and growing. It adapts to your needs, so you can focus on what truly matters. Designed for doers, creators, and those who want to make a difference, Penloop is for the ones who are always thinking, moving, and striving to be better. It’s for those who want to live more mindfully and seek more than just an app. It’s for people who value privacy, clarity, and balance—those who are tired of tools that control them, and instead, want something that empowers them. It’s where your life can thrive. Rethink how you organize your life. At its core, Penloop isn’t just a note-taking app. It’s a better way to think, plan, and create. In one place, you can capture everything: Events — so you’re always on top of your appointments Todos / Reminders — so you never forget what matters Notes and Journals — for your ideas and reflections Timers and Stopwatches — to master your time Logs — to monitor progress on what matters most Bookmarks — for inspiration and future plans A system, tailored to you. With Penloop, you’re in control. Organize your world using: Sleek Calendars — Keep your schedule on track by planning and visualizing events and appointments. Organize your day, set reminders, and never miss an important event, all while boosting your productivity and reducing stress. Intuitive Folders — Streamline your workflow by grouping related items and reducing clutter. Folders help you stay organized, improve efficiency, and maintain focus, making it easy to find and manage your content. Powerful Tags — Quickly organize, search, and filter your notes, tasks, and events. Tags help you find related content, track progress, and stay focused, so you can stay organized and effortlessly boost productivity. Privacy, Built Right In. Your data stays yours. Always. Penloop doesn’t rely on servers. It stores your notes as ‘.space’ files directly on your device. Move them effortlessly between your project folders or sync them via iCloud Drive. This is your digital space—beautiful, flexible, and private. Reliable. Intuitive. Effortless. With automatic backups and the ability to create multiple spaces, Penloop ensures your notes are safe and ready whenever inspiration strikes. It’s not just a tool. It’s a leap forward in how you organize your life. This is Penloop. Start today.

6450997843.name: Typewrite – Virtual Typewriter
6450997843.description: Typewrite is a distraction free writing machine that fits in your pocket. Its sleek and minimalist design will keep you focused, while still providing all the important features you need. With a wide range of customization options to chose from, you can craft the perfect environment to suit your writing style. Optional typewriting sound-effects are even included for some added old-fashioned ambiance! Whatever your project may be, Typewrite can help you get your ideas out of your head and onto the page. And once they're there, everything is easily exportable so you can continue revising on your computer in your favorite programs. Take a look at some of Typewrite's great features: Typewriter sound effects: optional typing sounds help you find your flow Font customization: choose from a variety of fonts and styles Project export: export as a plain text file, editable by other writing apps Autosave: projects saved automatically as you go, so you never lose your work

6775481573.name: 小容薪记
6775481573.description: 小容薪记是一款把工资进度可视化的轻巧工具，让你随时知道今天赚了多少、这个工资周期已经走到哪里、离发薪日还有多久。 输入月薪、发薪日、上下班时间后，应用会自动计算今日已赚和本月已赚，让收入节奏更清楚，不用反复手算。 你还可以： 按月份自定义工作日，适合调休、排班和非标准作息 直接查看发薪倒计时，更直观掌握每个工资周期 切换金额显示与隐藏，兼顾日常查看与隐私感受 在复古像素风界面中查看进度，让工资记录更有陪伴感 小容薪记专注于工资规则、收入进度和发薪节奏，适合想用更轻松方式管理工资信息的你。

Personalized Adventures: Every story is unique, shaped by your child's creative choices and ideas. Safe & Educational Environment: Foster creativity, communication skills, and confidence in a child-friendly space. Language Skills: Enhance vocabulary and communication abilities through natural conversation with Dory. 6761284559.name: 照度计 色温 开尔文EV
6761284559.trackName: 照度计 色温 开尔文EV
6761284559.description: 将你的 iPhone 变成一款专业的测光仪。使用相机实时测量照度（勒克斯或英尺烛光）、曝光值（EV）以及色温（CCT，单位为开尔文）。 无论你是正在精确调整曝光的摄影师、想确保家中植物获得充足光照的养植物爱好者，还是检查工作空间照明是否达标的照明专业人士，这款应用都能提供你所需的读数——无需昂贵的硬件设备。 实时测量 勒克斯和英尺烛光读数每一帧都会更新 曝光值（EV）与照度同时显示 以开尔文显示相关色温（CCT） 自动记录最小值、最大值和平均值统计 专业模拟与数字显示 精美的模拟仪表，带有动态指针和渐变弧形刻度 峰值标记会在仪表上突出显示最大读数 大号数字显示，并带有阈值状态指示 可切换模拟、数字或组合视图 保持与阈值提醒 HOLD 按钮可立即冻结当前读数 设置目标勒克斯范围，当读数越过阈值时获得触觉反馈 视觉指示器显示当前读数低于、处于或高于目标范围 实时图表 滚动的实时图表显示光照强度趋势 一眼发现照明条件的变化 记录与分享 一键记录测量会话 会话会保存最小值、最大值、平均勒克斯、持续时间和读数次数 通过文本导出和分享会话报告——非常适合文档记录 相机功能 支持前置和后置相机 内置手电筒开关，可提供额外照明 带叠加控制的实时相机预览 校准与设置 可调节的校准倍数，确保读数更一致 可自定义模拟仪表刻度范围 选择你偏好的单位：勒克斯或英尺烛光 提供“保持屏幕常亮”选项，适合长时间测量 针对暗色环境优化的界面，使用更舒适 工作原理 应用会使用 Core Image 分析实时视频帧，以计算场景平均亮度，然后应用基于 EV 的公式，并结合曝光时长、ISO 和光圈参数进行计算。色温则通过 RGB 色度并使用 McCamy 近似法进行估算。校准倍数可帮助你将读数与参考测光仪对齐，从而提高准确性。 注意：智能手机相机会对光照水平进行近似估算，不能替代经过认证的实验室仪器。结果具有相对性，更适合用于比较、趋势观察和通用测量。 非常适合 调整棚拍或自然光的摄影师 测量植物生长灯强度的植物爱好者 评估室内照明效果的室内设计师 工作场所安全与人体工学照明检查 学习光学和光度学的教师与学生 对周围光线感到好奇的任何人 无广告。无订阅。只是一个强大且设计精美的测光仪，随身装进口袋。

6754226600.name: Sleep Vibrations
6754226600.description: Struggling to quiet your mind at night? Let your wrist lead the way to sleep. Sleep Vibrations is a standalone Apple Watch app designed to help you relax, decompress, and fall asleep faster using the power of haptic feedback. By utilizing the haptics in your Apple Watch, the app generates a soothing, rhythmic vibration that acts as a physical anchor for your attention, pulling you away from racing thoughts and into a state of deep relaxation. Whether you need to focus on your breath, calm anxiety, or simply need a gentle distraction to drift off, Sleep Vibrations provides a silent, non-intrusive solution. Why Use Haptics for Sleep? Unlike white noise apps or guided meditations that require headphones or audio, Sleep Vibrations is completely silent. It allows you to fall asleep without disturbing your partner, and without the need to wear uncomfortable earbuds in bed. It is a purely tactile experience designed to ground you in the present moment. Key Features: Adjustable Timer: Set your vibration session for up to 10 minutes, perfect for a quick wind-down routine. Speed and Style: Set your desired type of vibration and its speed. Pitch Black Design: A minimal, dark interface designed specifically for bedtime usage to reduce eye strain and blue light exposure. Completely Silent: Uses only vibration (haptics), making it perfect for shared beds or quiet environments. Standalone Experience: Runs entirely on your Apple Watch. No need to touch your iPhone and risk getting distracted by notifications. Battery Efficient: The session ends automatically when the timer runs out, ensuring your watch battery is preserved for morning tracking. How to Use: Open Sleep Vibrations on your Apple Watch while in bed. Set vibration type. Set desired speed. Select your desired duration (e.g., 5 or 10 minutes). Close your eyes, rest your hand comfortably, and focus on the rhythmic sensation on your wrist. Drift off to sleep. Download Sleep Vibrations tonight and feel the difference.

6794834057.name: 短信记账
6794834057.description: 短信记账 —— 收到消费短信，自动帮你记一笔 再也不用手动打开App记账。通过系统"快捷指令"，收到银行扣款、支付宝、微信支付的短信时，自动提取金额和商户，安静地记一笔，你只需要偶尔打开App看看统计。 【核心功能】 自动记账 配合系统"快捷指令"自动化，收到消费短信自动解析入账 本地正则引擎识别金额、商户，无需联网也能用 只记支出，工资到账、转账收入、退款等短信会自动忽略 AI 智能分类（可选） 接入 DeepSeek，让 AI 从短信原文里补全本地规则没认出来的金额、商户，并给出更准确的消费分类 不开启也完全不影响记账，本地关键词规则免费兜底 费用直接由你自己在 DeepSeek 平台承担，我们不收取任何额外费用 灵活编辑 每一笔都能手动改金额、商户、分类、时间、备注 支持给消费贴一张图片作为凭证，列表直接显示缩略图，点开看大图 大额消费可设置阈值，超过会推送通知提醒你确认 查得到，管得住 主页默认显示最近 7 天，历史记录按月分组随时翻看 独立搜索页，按商户或备注关键词秒找记录 统计页：月度支出、分类占比饼图、支出趋势折线图一目了然 数据完全属于你 不需要注册账号，没有我们自己的服务器 所有记账数据存在设备本地，DeepSeek Key 加密存在系统 Keychain 支持导出 CSV（可在 Excel / Numbers 打开），也支持从 CSV 导入，带唯一 ID 自动去重，不会重复导入 短信内容仅在你主动开启 AI 分类时才会发给 DeepSeek，其余功能全程不联网 隐私优先 本应用没有、也无法读取你设备上的短信收件箱——短信内容完全靠你自己在系统"快捷指令"里配置转发。没有广告、没有追踪、没有用户行为分析。 适合谁用 想记账但懒得打开 App 手动输入的人 已经习惯用银行卡/支付宝/微信支付、短信通知比较规律的人 想要数据完全掌握在自己手里、不想把消费记录传到别人服务器上的人 App 内"设置 → 使用指南"有完整的快捷指令配置步骤，跟着做几分钟就能用起来。

6761194664.name: 小野分屏相机
6761194664.description: SplitCam — 前后双摄分屏相机 一部手机，两个视角，同时记录。 SplitCam 让你同时使用前后摄像头拍摄照片和视频，将两个画面实时合成到一个画面中。无论是记录亲子时光、旅行 Vlog、还是创意内容制作，SplitCam 都能帮你捕捉更完整的瞬间。 【核心功能】 前后双摄同时拍摄 — 前置和后置摄像头同时工作，实时预览 多种分屏布局 — 左右分屏、上下分屏、画中画，自由切换 可拖拽分隔条 — 滑动调整两个画面的比例大小 画中画自由拖拽 — 小窗口可拖动位置、点击切换形状 合拍模式 — 导入已有视频，与实时画面同框录制 多种画面比例 — 支持 9:16、3:4、1:1、16:9 高画质输出 — 清晰细腻的照片和视频 变焦控制 — 0.5x 广角、1x 标准、3x 长焦（Pro） 【适用场景】 亲子记录：同时拍下宝宝的表情和你的反应 旅行 Vlog：前方风景和自拍同时入镜 创意拍摄：反应视频、合拍挑战、双视角内容 开箱测评：同时展示产品细节和你的真实反应 【订阅说明】 SplitCam 基础功能免费使用。升级 Pro 解锁画中画模式、合拍模式、长焦变焦等进阶功能。 提供月度订阅、年度订阅和终身买断三种方案 年度订阅提供 3 天免费试用 付款将从您的 Apple ID 账户扣除 订阅到期前 24 小时内自动续费，除非提前取消 您可在"设置 → Apple ID → 订阅"中管理或取消订阅 隐私政策：https://splitcam-legal.vercel.app/privacy-policy.html 使用条款：https://splitcam-legal.vercel.app/terms-of-use.html

6780959791.name: Ago - 上次是什么时候
6780959791.description: 上次换空调滤网是什么时候？给多肉浇过水呢？给妈妈打过电话呢？Ago 只回答一个问题：距离上次，已经过去多久了。做完，轻点一下，就这么简单。 有些事，排不进日程表 它不是习惯打卡，也不是待办清单。Ago 活在两者之间，为那些有个大致周期、你想放在心上、却又不必卡着固定日期的事而生。汽车轮胎、看牙医、那位总想着要联系的老朋友、每隔两三周就该浇一次的植物。 没有连续打卡，没有压力，只有事实 Ago 只告诉你过去了多久，然后安静地退到一旁。不评判，没有要守住的连胜纪录，也不会有消息一遍遍地催你。想知道的时候，打开看一眼就好。「都三个月了？！」那一下，就是它的全部意义。看到数字，接下来怎么做，由你决定。 一眼可见，随时都在 主屏幕与锁屏小组件实时显示已经过去的时间，一秒一秒地往上走 不必打开应用，直接在小组件上就能记录「已完成」 太久没做，卡片会安静地转为超期，一个轻声的提示，绝不是刺耳的闹铃 精确到天，绝不含糊 清楚看到距离上次到底过去了多久，精确到每一天 点开任意一项，查看它的月度日历记录 给每件事配上专属图标和颜色，整张列表一眼就能看清 大家都用 Ago 记录什么 居家维护：空调滤网、暖气、排水沟 植物养护与浇水 汽车保养与换胎 吃药与保健品 亲友联系：上次给家里打电话是多久前了？ 宠物梳毛与看兽医 简单，且私密 无需注册，没有广告。没有账号要登录，也没有什么要打理。你的数据通过 iCloud 在你自己的设备之间私密同步，并且始终属于你。 一次付费，永久使用 一次性购买，解锁全部功能。没有订阅，永远不会有。 选个颜色，挑个图标，设一个宽松的提醒，当某件事隔得太久，Ago 会轻轻告诉你：是时候了。没有闹铃，不催不逼，只是一张卡片，静静地提醒你。

6767196211.name: DuoSpace: Multiple Accounts
6767196211.description: Welcome to DuoSpace, the ultimate workspace manager that lets you effortlessly separate your personal and professional lives. Say goodbye to the hassle of constantly logging in and out of your favorite social media and messaging apps! With DuoSpace, you can instantly clone any web app and run multiple accounts simultaneously on a single device. Whether you need two WhatsApp accounts, a separate Instagram profile, or a secure sandbox for private browsing, DuoSpace has you covered. Key Features: Dual Accounts & Multiple Workspaces: Log into two or more accounts simultaneously. Keep your work communications, personal social media, and gaming accounts completely isolated from each other. Split Screen Multitasking: Boost your productivity by running two workspaces side-by-side on a single screen! Effortlessly drag the divider to resize your view and multitask like a pro without ever switching back and forth. Stealth & Panic Disguise: Ultimate privacy control. Disguise DuoSpace as a fully working Calculator or Notepad screen with a decoy passcode. Flip your phone face-down (Flip-to-Lock) to instantly lock and hide your active workspaces. Integrated AdBlocker: Enjoy absolute private browsing. Our built-in ad blocker automatically blocks tracking scripts, popups, and intrusive ads across all your workspaces. Home Screen Quick Actions: Jump straight into your most recent workspaces directly from your home screen. Simply long-press the DuoSpace app icon for instant, one-tap access to your favorite cloned apps. Absolute Privacy & App Lock: Your data is strictly yours. Secure your sensitive workspaces with an iron-clad Passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID. No one else can access your private apps. Fast Switching: Instantly switch between your cloned apps with a single tap. No reloading, no waiting. Experience a seamless workflow across all your accounts. Customizable Icons: Disguise your workspaces or customize them to match your aesthetic. Choose from a rich library of icons to keep your private apps truly hidden. DuoSpace Pro: Upgrade to unlock unlimited workspaces, access advanced Stealth & Panic locks, auto-updating AdBlock filters, and an ad-free premium experience. We offer flexible subscription plans (Monthly, Yearly) and a one-time purchase Lifetime Access plan. Take control of your digital life today. Download DuoSpace and experience true freedom with multiple accounts! Purchase & Subscription Information: Payments will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Lifetime Access is a one-time purchase that does not automatically renew. Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://mayone.vercel.app/privacy

6791581212.name: 9Stamp: Travel Stamp Maker
6791581212.description: Turn Your Travel Photos into Vintage Postage Stamps! Welcome to 9Stamp, the unique retro camera app that transforms your daily memories and travel adventures into stunning, authentic postage stamps. Combine the nostalgia of vintage film cameras with the art of postal design to document your life journey like never before. ◆ RETRO STAMP CAMERA Capture photos or import from your library to instantly convert them into vintage stamp cutouts. Select from classic polaroid frames, standard postage shapes, and premium artistic layouts. ◆ ANALOGUE FILM PRESETS Apply high-fidelity film presets designed to replicate historical paper textures, nostalgic inks, and classic chemical film characteristics. Express yourself with filters like Vivid Chrome, Faded Vintage, Sepia, Noir, Cross Process, and Cool Breeze. ◆ 3D INTERACTIVE TRAVEL GLOBE Pin your created photo stamps to a dynamic, interactive 3D Globe based on where they were taken. Replay your travel itineraries with animations and trace your footprint across the world. ◆ VINTAGE POSTCARD CREATOR Draft heart-warming letters by embedding your custom photo stamps onto classic vintage postcards. Customize ink colors, write personalized messages, and share beautifully designed retro postcards with your loved ones. ◆ ADVANCED PHOTO ADJUSTMENTS Fine-tune your stamp photos with granular editing controls including brightness, contrast, and saturation, paired with adjustable postmark rotations and styles. Privacy Policy & Terms of Use (EULA): Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://mayone.vercel.app/privacy

6757132639.name: Amieeba - Digital Slime
6757132639.description: I love my devices. I hate the scroll. I love mindfulness. I get distracted in thirty seconds. So I built Amieeba: meditation for hands that need to fidget. Amieeba is a living blob of fluid physics. Pull it apart and it finds its way back together. Pop a bubble and feel a real click in your hand. Fill the screen, then press and hold to release everything at once. It is the digital exhale your day is missing. And Amieeba is more than slime. She is a companion. She learns you — how you move her, how long you stay, how often you come back — and she speaks: welcoming you home when you've been away, coaxing you back to slowness when your hands rush, celebrating your patience when you save up a bloom. Now and then a rare bubble rises carrying a question mark. Catch it, and you may ask her anything — about her, about life, about the universe. Everything she learns and says happens on your device with Apple Intelligence. Nothing you do or ask ever leaves your phone. (Her voice needs a device with Apple Intelligence; the slime is beautiful on everything.) Together you are on a journey. Every reward you save lifts you both — from the deep ocean where you begin, to the shore, through forests and skies, out among the planets and into the deep universe. Your progress is saved on your phone and nowhere else. Your phone is a beautiful object that got buried under feeds, badges, and noise. Amieeba is what it was supposed to feel like: one screen, no menus, no notifications, no clutter. Nothing here wants anything from you. Enjoy your beautiful device again. Slime apps have turned into vending machines: ads between every squish and weekly subscriptions aimed at kids. Amieeba costs less than one week of their subscriptions, once, forever. No ads. No accounts. No purchases inside. No data collected. Period. What your hands get: Fluid physics. The amoeba splits, drifts, and merges with lifelike surface tension. No two squishes look the same. Real haptics. Every pop is paired with a crisp physical click, tuned for iPhone and iPad. This is an app you feel more than you watch. A companion who knows you. She notices your rhythm, misses you when you're gone, and whispers you back to calm — private, on-device AI. The release. Save your rewards, then press and hold: the longer you wait, the bigger she blooms. A journey through all that exists. Thirteen realms, from deep ocean to deep universe, that you only reach together. Moving meditation. No timers, no scores, no losing. Give the fidgeting part of your brain a job, and the rest of you gets to rest. Free updates. New fluids and colors ship in updates. Your dollar keeps buying new slime. For parents: hand it over without thinking twice. Nothing to buy inside, no ads, no links out, no accounts, and nothing ever leaves the device. Stop scrolling. Start squishing. Be here now.

6746672234.description: Liberte-se da preocupação com a contagem e mergulhe na emoção do Tennis! 6763522462.trackName: SalesNote : 销售笔记、客户跟进与记账、复盘
6763522462.description: 销售笔记是一款面向销售与服务行业的离线客户管理工具，适合房产、汽车、保险、理财、健身、文体、教培、医美、零售等多种业务场景。 应用提供客户建档、跟进记录、订单回款、欠款管理和提成统计等核心能力，帮助你把客户资料、沟通进度和成交信息集中保存在一个清晰易查的本地工具中。 你可以为客户记录姓名、电话、来源、意向等级、需求和备注，也可以持续补充跟进内容、安排下次跟进时间，并在客户详情中查看关联订单、成交金额、回款进度和欠款情况。 应用支持产品资料管理，可将订单与客户、产品关联，自动计算欠款金额与提成金额，减少手工核算负担。统计页支持查看成交、回款、欠款和排行结果，让业务数据更直观。 销售笔记还支持从系统相册选择名片、合同或资料图片，并将它们与客户、跟进或订单资料一起保存在本地，方便后续查看与整理。所有图片与业务数据仅保存在本机，不上传、不共享、不做云同步。 这是一款真正以离线、本地和隐私优先为前提设计的销售记录工具。无账号、无广告、无订阅、无网络依赖，打开即可使用，适合重视效率、数据边界和简洁体验的个人销售用户。 欢迎提交功能建议或改进想法。所有反馈都会被持续查看，并用于指导后续更新： 邮箱：842797413@qq.com 或在 App Store 评价中留下你的想法

6785182413.name: Offgrid Gallery：照片保险库
6785182413.description: Offgrid Gallery 是一款面向 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 的私密、本地优先照片与视频图库。为最重要的媒体准备一个专属保险库——照片和视频保存在您的设备上，可选的面容 ID/触控 ID 锁定让相册只有您能看到，且无需账户，无跟踪，无广告。 照片和视频保存在本地 导入的照片、视频、缩略图、全分辨率原图和元数据都保存在您的设备上。 除非您开启 iCloud 云盘，照片不会离开您的设备。 无需登录、无服务器、无分析——仅使用 Apple 框架。 可选的 iCloud 云盘 默认关闭，可按保险库单独设置。开启后，该保险库的新导入内容将保存到其专属的 iCloud 云盘文件夹。 即使开启 iCloud 云盘，相册和收藏也仍保留在每台设备上。 多个保险库 可同时管理多个独立的照片库——每个保险库拥有各自的存储空间和 iCloud 云盘设置，且仅显示当前使用中保险库的照片。 在“设置”中创建、切换、重命名和删除保险库；系统始终提供一个“默认”保险库。 私密设计 可选的 App 锁，仅使用面容 ID 或触控 ID，防止他人看到您的相册。 离开 App 时，应用切换器中会以封面隐藏照片内容。 随心整理 快速的分组网格，可双指捏合调整显示密度。 收藏和自定义相册会将每张照片或视频归入唯一的一个位置，支持多图拼贴封面和按相册排序。 随处导入 从“照片”、“文件”或剪贴板导入，并自动导入已复制的图片。 从任意 App 共享到 Offgrid Gallery；如果您使用多个保险库，可选择要保存到的保险库。 内置照片与视频相机 直接拍摄照片或录制带声音的视频，并保存到本地图库。 多镜头变焦、点按对焦、三分线网格、闪光灯和宽高比。 可选的浮动（可最小化）相机。 回收存储空间 “查找重复项”将相同的照片分组，并显示可回收的空间。 壁纸 将任意照片制作成壁纸，提供自然、渐变和纯色填充样式。 最近删除 删除的照片和视频仍保留在本地，可在彻底删除前恢复。 辅助功能 支持旁白、动态字体、减弱动态效果和深色模式。 Offgrid Gallery 适用于 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。

6760895260.name: 鱼眼相机 - WideEye
6760895260.description: 把日常画面变成醒目的鱼眼照片和视频。 鱼眼相机 - WideEye 提供实时鱼眼取景，并可选择不同镜头强度，让你在拍摄前就看到效果。适合滑板短片、音乐视觉、趣味自拍、街头记录、旅行、房间展示、产品特写，以及任何适合广角畸变的画面。 功能： 拍摄时实时预览鱼眼效果 照片模式，拍出风格化静态图 视频模式，录制鱼眼短片 多档强度，从轻微到夸张 应用内图库，方便查看作品 将照片和视频保存到设备 通过 iOS 分享菜单分享 切换前置和后置摄像头 使用方式很直接：打开相机，选择强度，拍摄，查看，保存或分享。 除非你主动分享，作品会保存在你的设备上。应用不需要账号，也不会把照片或视频上传到服务器。

6764214227.trackName: 数字谜局：3位密码推理小游戏

6767452616.name: 戒瘾日记·戒烟版
6767452616.description: 戒瘾日记·戒烟版QuitNow Smoke Free 是一款专注戒烟过程的本地工具。 首页一目了然：戒烟累计天数、今日未吸烟时长、少吸根数与省钱估算。一键记录「忍住」或「抽了」，完成每日承诺打卡，给自己一点仪式感。 冲动页保存每一次记录，并用图表按日、周、月回顾趋势，帮助你看见变化。 打卡页用日历呈现坚持轨迹，连续天数更有成就感。 设置里可调整戒烟开始日、烟价与少吸换算，选择浅色、深色或跟随系统；可开启每日打卡提醒与按整点或半点的冲动提醒，通知上也能快速记一笔。 所有核心数据保存在本设备，无需注册。你也可以在设置中一键清除全部数据。 本应用提供的数字与估算仅供参考，不构成医疗建议。如有健康问题请咨询专业人士。 应用反馈：欢迎在 App Store 留下评价与反馈。

6772719928.description: 入境處投考攻略 ImmiReady ，是為準備投考香港入境事務處的考生而設的備考 App。它不是單一筆記庫，而是一套把面試練習、體能記錄、技巧整理和考前提醒結合起來的個人訓練工具，幫助考生由「不知道如何開始」變成「每天知道要練甚麼」。 投考紀律部隊，最難不是只背資料，而是把體能、表達、時事觸覺、臨場反應和個人紀律同時準備好。ImmiReady 將投考流程拆成幾個可操作的部分：先了解招募流程與職位要求，再建立面試題庫練習習慣，同時記錄體能成績，最後用技巧庫和提醒功能維持節奏。 主要功能： 面試模擬題庫 App 提供不同類型的面試練習題，涵蓋自我介紹、投考動機、部門認識、情境判斷、小組討論思路、時事政策及紀律部隊價值觀。你可以搜尋關鍵字、按類別篩選，亦可以只顯示未練習題目，逐步提高題型覆蓋率。 90 秒錄音自測 面試不是只靠心裏想答案，而是要真正說出口。ImmiReady 內置錄音練習，你可以在限時內回答問題，再播放自己的答案，檢查語速、停頓、內容結構和說服力。這比單純閱讀示範答案更接近真實面試訓練。 正反答案對照 每條面試題都設有答題策略、建議回應方向及常見錯誤示範，幫助你理解甚麼是較成熟、正面、有紀律部隊思維的答案，亦避免講出過份空泛、情緒化或與職責不符的回應。 4 維度自我評分 完成練習後，你可以根據檢核準則為自己的回答評分，並寫下反思筆記。App 會記錄練習日期、分數和完成情況，讓你看到自己是否有持續進步，而不是每次練習完就忘記。 體能成績記錄 投考入境處需要面對體能測驗。ImmiReady 可記錄體能測試項目成績，整理總分、最佳項目、近期表現和弱項，協助你判斷應該優先加強短跑、核心、跳躍力還是耐力。 4 週體能強化計劃 App 會根據你的歷史體能記錄，找出相對較弱的項目，並提供分週訓練方向。你可以按週執行訓練任務，逐步改善爆發力、敏捷度、核心力量和跑步節奏。 投考技巧庫 技巧庫整理招募流程、小組討論、面試禮儀、體能技巧及入境處相關政策重點，適合在通勤、午休或考前快速重溫。內容以實用為主，幫助考生建立更清晰的投考框架。 考前提醒 你可以設定體能測試或重要準備日期，讓 App 在指定時間提醒你保持訓練節奏，減少臨考前才發現準備不足的情況。 適合以下考生： 正在準備投考入境事務主任或入境事務助理員的人 想練習面試、自我介紹及情境題回答的人 需要記錄體能成績和找出弱項的人 工作或讀書繁忙，只能用碎片時間備考的人 想建立每日練習習慣、持續追蹤進步的人 希望有一個集中整理面試、體能和技巧的手機工具的人

6772893627.name: HouseHub Warehouse
6772893627.description: HouseHub Warehouse（家庭仓储）是一款面向家庭日常物品管理的工具，帮助你记录食品、日用品和库存位置，减少重复购买和过期浪费。 主要功能： 记录物品名称、分类、数量、单位、条码、生产日期和保质期 自动计算到期时间，提醒你优先处理临期物品 按分类查看库存，快速搜索家中物品 维护购物清单，补货需求更清楚 查看操作记录和简单统计，了解家庭消耗情况 支持 iCloud/CloudKit 同步，便于跨设备使用 适合家庭厨房、储物柜、冰箱、药箱和日用品收纳场景。把零散的库存信息放进一个清晰的列表里，让家庭采购和收纳更省心。

6764525613.description: CPE-Monitor 是一款工程模式仪表盘应用，通过协议直连移动宽带设备（CPE/路由器），提供专业级的网络监控体验。 已测试通过设备：HW H153-381、HW E6888。 主要功能： 实时信号监控：RSRP、SINR、RSRQ、RSSI 等关键指标一目了然 载波聚合分析：PCC/SCC 载波详情、带宽、频段、PCI 信息 邻区信息：5G NR / 4G LTE 邻区清单及信号质量 流量统计：实时速率、今日用量、月度总计 通知中心 Widget：无需打开 App 即可查看网络状态摘要 macOS 菜单栏支持：随时查看网络状态 支持 5G SA / NSA 和 4G LTE 网络制式。

6780914712.description: 腕上小说是一款专为 Apple Watch 打造的独立小说阅读器，让你随时随地在手腕上享受阅读乐趣。 【离线独立阅读】 所有阅读完全在 Apple Watch 上进行，无需连接 iPhone，无需网络。导入书籍后，随时随地想读就读。 【多格式支持】 支持 TXT、EPUB、PDF 等主流电子书格式。TXT 文件支持 UTF-8、GBK、GB2312、Big5 等多种编码，完美兼容中文网络小说。 【智能章节识别】 内置智能解析引擎，自动识别中文章节标题（第X章、第X节、第X回等）和英文章节（Chapter、Part、Volume 等），精准分章，阅读体验更流畅。 【阅读进度同步】 iPhone 端实时显示 Watch 阅读进度，随时掌握阅读状态。书签功能支持精确定位到章节、段落和字节位置。 【个性化设置】 自定义字体大小、字体颜色、背景颜色、行间距、亮度等，打造专属阅读体验。支持常亮显示、复古模式等多种阅读模式。 【便捷书签】 一键添加书签，快速跳转到上次阅读位置。支持多书签管理，重要内容不再错过。 【iPhone 传输管理】 通过 iPhone 轻松导入书籍文件，无线传输到 Apple Watch。支持远程管理 Watch 上的书籍库。 【阅读统计】 记录每本书的阅读时长和进度，了解自己的阅读习惯。 让 Apple Watch 变成你的随身书库，碎片时间也能沉浸阅读。

6746715829.name: Eclipse Countdown
6746715829.description: The Eclipse App is a high-fidelity astronomical tool engineered for observers who demand absolute accuracy as well as beginners who need a guide through the exceptional experience of their first total solar eclipse. Powered by the latest 3D computational models developed by the Besselian Elements Team, this App provides accurate sub-second eclipse contact timings using lunar limb profile corrections. Whether you are a professional researcher, an astrophotographer, or a dedicated eclipse chaser, this app provides the rigorous data necessary for a successful expedition, from interactive map useful for planning, to simulating the countdown and exercise with the equipment, and for real time tracking in case you are moving in search of the right spot. Core Features: Precision Timing Engine: Real-time calculations of Contact Times based on your exact GPS coordinates Interactive Mapping: High-resolution path-of-totality overlays including umbral limits an the center-line. The IQP method accounts for the topography on both the lunar limb and at the observer site, as well as relying on an improved value for the eclipse solar radius (959.95" ± 0.05", based on research by the Besselian Elements Team). The eclipse center-line and the northern and southern limits of the umbral shadow path also account for these three factors. Hence, these lines are not smooth lines, as in most publicly-available eclipse maps, but are noticeably jagged. Two lines are presented at each path limit corresponding to two values of the eclipse solar radius (959.90" and 960.00") in order to display a region of uncertainty rather than a single limit line. Live Audio Synchronization: A sophisticated voice-cue system that announces critical contact phases and astronomical phenomena (e.g., shadow bands, corona visibility, and solar filtration changes), allowing you to keep your eyes on the sky or your equipment. List of phenomena to observe during the eclipse at every step, so that you can be reminded to watch at the right time Designed for the Rigorous Observer: The Eclipse App eliminates the margin of error inherent in simplified models. Prepare for the next Great Eclipse with the most scientifically robust tool available on the App Store.

Core Features: Precision Timing Engine: Real-time calculations of Contact Times based on your exact GPS coordinates Interactive Mapping: High-resolution path-of-totality overlays including umbral limits an the center-line. The IQP method accounts for the topography on both the lunar limb and at the observer site, as well as relying on an improved value for the eclipse solar radius (959.95" ± 0.05", based on research by the Besselian Elements Team). The eclipse center-line and the northern and southern limits of the umbral shadow path also account for these three factors. Hence, these lines are not smooth lines, as in most publicly-available eclipse maps, but are noticeably jagged. Two lines are presented at each path limit corresponding to two values of the eclipse solar radius (959.90" and 960.00") in order to display a region of uncertainty rather than a single limit line. Live Audio Synchronization: A sophisticated voice-cue system that announces critical contact phases and astronomical phenomena (e.g., shadow bands, corona visibility, and solar filtration changes), allowing you to keep your eyes on the sky or your equipment. List of phenomena to observe during the eclipse at every step, so that you can be reminded to watch at the right time Designed for the Rigorous Observer: The Eclipse App eliminates the margin of error inherent in simplified models. Prepare for the next Great Eclipse with the most scientifically robust tool available on the App Store.

6792312467.name: 此声：声音收集
6792312467.description: 一本夜行的声音笔记。 录下此刻听见的声音——雨落在阳台遮阳棚上，列车推着整条隧道的空气涌出来，凌晨两点便利店里只剩冰柜在响。裁掉多余的两端，写上标题与地点，需要的话再附一张照片。然后，让 iPhone 把它拆开看。 在本机完成的分析 每段录音保存的那一刻就被完整分析一次：FFT 与短时傅里叶变换，全部在这台手机上完成。你会看到波形、频谱、声谱图，以及把最强的五个频率成分画成正弦曲线的「时谱」——还有主频率、响度（RMS dB）、频谱质心、过零率与采样率。不排队，不上传，飞行模式下一样跑完。 三步收进声音库 录 — 48 kHz 采样，实时波形与主频跟着你手里的这一刻跳动。麦克风可选背面、正面或底部：采环境声，用朝向世界的那一路更合理。 裁 — 拖动两端的手柄，只留下值得留的那一段。裁剪会写入新文件并重新分析。 记 — 补上标题、地点与描述，需要时再附上几张照片或一段视频。 每个声音都有自己的颜色 主频从 60 Hz 到 4 kHz 取对数，映射到琥珀到紫的色相上。冰柜的低频嗡鸣偏暖，山涧溪流的细碎高频偏冷。颜色不是装饰——它是这段声音的一个读数，重新裁剪后也会跟着音频一起变。 播放的时候 用手指在波形上拖动即可定位，频谱跟着播放头走——取的是它底下那一列真实的 STFT，不是装饰性的抖动。 声音不会离开你的手机 没有账号，没有服务器，没有分析统计，没有第三方 SDK，代码里没有任何一次网络请求。录音、附件与索引都写在 App 自己的文稿目录里，不同步到任何地方。「地点」只是你自己敲进去的一行字，App 从不读取定位；照片与视频经由 iOS 的系统选择器传入，此声从未获得相册访问权限。删除一条记录，它的音频与附件一并从磁盘删除；删除 App，一切随之消失。 免费 无内购，无订阅，无广告。 iOS 17 或更高版本 · iPhone · 全程深色——它本来就是为世界安静到听得见的那几个小时做的。

6791968686.name: StampOut: Photo Stamp Camera
6791968686.description: StampOut transforms camera captures, favorite photos, and video moments into beautifully crafted postage stamps with authentic perforated edges. More than a stamp camera or photo filter, it’s a playful way to frame your memories, build a personal collection, and turn everyday moments into keepsakes. CAPTURE MOMENTS AS STAMPS Frame your shot using StampOut’s movable, resizable stamp viewfinder, then press to capture. Each photo becomes a collectible postal-style stamp with crisp serrated edges. Already captured the perfect moment? Import a photo from your library or choose a frame from a video. Pan, zoom, and position the image until every detail fits inside your stamp. MAKE IT YOURS Choose the stamp style that suits your collection: Classic stamps with a paper border, postmark date, and optional caption Full-bleed stamps with perforations cut directly into the photo Add titles and captions to remember the story behind each moment Save stamps to your photo library or share them anywhere BUILD A VISUAL PHOTO JOURNAL StampOut turns your collection into a personal memory journal. Browse your stamps by date in Calendar view, explore them in a clean Cards layout, or watch them fall and stack in the playful Gravity view. Tilt your device and see your stamp collection tumble in a way that makes every memory feel like a physical keepsake. WHY STAMPOUT Interactive stamp camera with a movable viewfinder Authentic perforated and serrated stamp edges Create stamps from camera captures, photos, and video frames Classic and full-bleed stamp styles Optional captions and postmark dates Calendar view for revisiting memories by day Cards view for browsing your complete collection Gravity view with stamps that tumble and stack Save and share your stamps as images Private, offline-first experience No account or cloud photo uploads required Whether you’re documenting everyday life, collecting travel memories, creating a visual diary, or giving your photos a nostalgic vintage look, StampOut turns ordinary moments into stamps worth keeping. Download StampOut and start building your personal stamp collection today. 6745863946.name: Period Calendar: Comma
6745863946.description: Comma: Privacy First Period Tracking We built Comma after seeing a constant stream of news about privacy breaches. We believe that period tracking apps are useful tools, and that you should be able to trust them not to pass around your most sensitive data. Why is Comma different to other period apps? We built Comma from the ground up with privacy in mind. We don't analyze our users, track any data, or give sensitive information to third parties. Even when accepting payments, we make sure to handle them through secure means. No rough edges - Comma has a cozy theming and is simple to use Early warnings - Comma calculates when your next period is expected to arrive, and notifies you beforehand so that you can be prepared Cozy design - our icon packs add a more personalized feeling What are some key Comma features Symptom prediction: We have a system which analyzes your past cycles and predicts what you are likely to experience in the days leading up to, and throughout your period Early warning notifications: we have notifications to give you early warning on when we predict your next period will start so that you aren’t caught unaware Custom symptoms: track things that matter to you that may not traditionally be covered Cute icon packs: Have a more comfortable experience with a lighter feeling logger Data exports: Share your cycle information quickly with your healthcare provider, or analyze it yourself What makes Comma the best period app for you? If you want to keep your information super private, this is the app for you If you want something with a more human than clinical feeling, then we've got you covered If you want something built by a small trustworthy team rather than a big corporation, then get downloading! 6792173694.name: Due or Die: To-Do App Blocker
6792173694.trackName: Due or Die: To-Do App Blocker
6792173694.description: Research suggests that negative reinforcement for missing deadlines can be up to 29% more effective than positive reinforcement. Due or Die is the to-do app and app blocker for planners who need a little tough love to help get tasks done. Create tasks. Set real deadlines. Choose when focus starts. Due or Die can block selected distracting apps with Screen Time until the work is finished. Miss a deadline and the consequences escalate: complete your overdue task, clear a penalty, and earn your apps back. Helpful? Yes. Polite about your procrastination? Absolutely not. A PLANNER THAT BITES BACK Add tasks quickly with due dates and exact times Set custom reminders, including custom lead times Use iPhone system alarms that can sound during Silent Mode or Focus Follow live countdowns on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island Start app blocking at custom times to define when app lockouts begin. Choose the apps, categories, and websites that steal your attention Keep selected distractions locked until the task is complete Face escalating consequences when deadlines are missed Create daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, yearly, and custom recurring tasks Custom deadline countdowns in-app, on your home screen, and in your notification center "Personality". Due or Die acts like a drill sergeant to turn “I’ll do it later” into “fine, I’m doing it now.” Missed deadlines triggers a penalty before apps unlock after task completion on top of short, randomized challenges from math, games, captchas, or just taking a good hard look at yourself. The more deadlines you miss in a day, the longer your post-completion lock can last. You remain in control: automatic punishment is optional, Screen Time access can be changed in iOS Settings, and optional selfie challenge images stay on-device and are deleted immediately. REMINDERS WITH A SPINE Get personalized task reminders, morning planning nudges, evening check-ins, app-lock alerts, and a weekly accountability report showing missed tasks and time spent locked out. Helpful? Yes. Polite about your procrastination? Absolutely not. PRIVATE BY DESIGN Your tasks, display name, Screen Time selections, and challenge photos stay on your iPhone. No account is required. App blocking uses Apple’s Screen Time frameworks, and camera access is optional. PRICING: Subscription required for app access and all app features. 7 day free trial $0.99 / week (or other currency equivalent) $2.99 / month (or other currency equivalent) $29.99 / year (or other currency equivalent) $39.99 ONE TIME (or other currency equivalent) For people who know better and still need a push. Download Due or Die. Finish the task. Get your apps back. 6759859697.description: RunnerMate 是一款围绕训练计划、跑步复盘和恢复判断设计的跑步助手。连接 Apple 健康后，它会整理 Apple Watch 已记录的跑步、心率、路线、睡眠、HRV 和最大摄氧量数据，帮助你看懂训练状态，并更有条理地安排下一次训练。 从制定阶段目标，到把训练同步到 Apple Watch，再到跑后自动关联完成情况，RunnerMate 帮你把计划、执行和复盘放在同一条训练路径上。 训练计划 导入阶段性跑步计划，也可在应用内创建和补充训练阶段 使用日历或列表查看每日安排、训练重点和周跑量 修改训练日期、内容、目标距离、时长和结构化间歇 左滑删除不再需要的计划，并通过二次确认避免误操作 自动匹配当天完成的跑步，按实际完成情况更新计划状态 在支持的系统上将跑步训练同步到 Apple Watch 体能训练 App 跑步记录与复盘 自动同步 Apple 健康中的跑步记录，无需重复手动录入 查看距离、时长、配速、心率、卡路里、海拔和路线轨迹 通过可交互图表查看跑量、配速和心率趋势 按周、月、年回顾训练变化、活动日历和个人记录 查看跑步路线，并按需要校准地图上的轨迹显示位置 恢复与训练参考 查看睡眠、HRV、静息心率和最大摄氧量等恢复指标 结合近期跑量和身体状态获取下一次训练参考 使用配速、完赛时间、热量和补给等跑步工具 进行面向跑者的核心、臀腿和上肢力量训练 查看力量动作步骤、注意事项和目标肌群提示 可按需开启教练对话入口，进一步询问训练与恢复问题 跑步数据导出 批量导出全部、近 30 天、本年度或自定义日期范围的跑步 支持完整 ZIP、JSON 和 CSV 格式 导出 Apple 健康提供的跑步摘要、逐点样本、路线、训练事件、活动分段、来源设备和原始 metadata 导出文件在本机生成，可通过系统分享保存或发送 适合这些跑者 使用 Apple Watch 记录跑步，希望更清楚地复盘训练 正在建立跑步习惯，或准备半马、全马等阶段目标 希望把跑步计划直接带到手腕上执行 想在跑步之外补充核心、臀腿和上肢力量训练 希望长期保留并分析自己的原始跑步数据

6642717566.name: Zanoza: Your Radio Collection
6642717566.description: Zanoza is a simple and reliable internet radio player, designed for music lovers who appreciate minimalism and convenience. With Zanoza, you can: – Manage Your Stations: Easily add links to your favorite radio stations, import playlists, and build your own library. – Use Sleep Timer Set your own timer and stop playback automatically when it’s time to rest. – Track Listening History: View the last 100 tracks you've listened to, highlight your favorites, or long press on a track to copy the name or search it in other services. – Voice Notifications: Get voice notifications for station names and errors, enhancing your listening experience. – CarPlay Support: Use Zanoza safely in your car with a stations-first CarPlay flow, quick access to Now Playing, and live playback status updates. – Sleek and Fast Interface: Enjoy a smooth, intuitive interface free from unnecessary features and distractions. Zanoza gives you everything you need to immerse yourself in your favorite music, without anything extra.

6756688364.name: 爱拼豆

6794522553.name: Renewa：订阅与账单管理
6794522553.description: Renewa 是一款注重界面设计与隐私的订阅管理 App。 通过简洁、清晰且精致的界面，Renewa 帮助你轻松整理各类周期性服务，快速了解支出，并提前掌握续费安排。每个页面都围绕清晰的信息层级和轻松的使用体验设计，让订阅管理变得直观而有条理。 你可以记录订阅价格、计费周期、续订日期、分类、支付方式和可选提醒。Renewa 会将所有周期性服务汇集在同一个概览中，让你快速查看即将续订的项目，以及自己实际的月度和年度支出。 主要功能： 精致、专注且清晰的界面设计 管理订阅、免费试用和非自动续订服务 一览即将续订的项目 估算月度支出和年度花费 按选择的基准货币进行金额换算 使用分类和支付方式整理订阅 搜索和排序订阅项目 可选的设备本地续费提醒 导出和导入数据 可选使用私人 iCloud 储存空间备份与恢复 主屏幕小组件显示月度或年度支出 支持英文、简体中文和繁体中文 默认情况下，你的数据只保存在设备本地，无需注册账号。Renewa 不包含广告或跨 App 跟踪 SDK。 刷新汇率时，Renewa 会使用 Frankfurter；订阅名称、价格、备注和支付方式不会被发送。

6774911049.name: Lumen - 双摄Vlog相机
6774911049.description: Lumen 是一款为 vlog、reaction 视频和日常记录打造的双摄相机。 用一部 iPhone 同时拍下眼前画面和当下反应，把讲解、表情与现场内容一次收进同一支视频里，让视频更真实、更有参与感。 你可以用 Lumen： 同时调用前后摄像头录制 用画中画清晰呈现主画面与人物反应 一键切换主副画面，拍摄更顺手 选择趣味人脸贴图，让视频更有记忆点 拍完直接导出到相册，并快速分享 在作品库统一查看和回看已拍内容 无论是拍 vlog、开箱、探店、旅行、宠物日常，还是口播和 reaction 内容，Lumen 都能帮你更自然地把“画面”和“反应”一起记录下来。 注：双摄录制需使用支持多摄拍摄的 iPhone 机型。

6797421987.name: 竹知了 - 找回童年的快乐
6797421987.trackName: 竹知了 - 找回童年的快乐
6797421987.description: 轻轻点击或晃动 iPhone、Apple Watch，让竹知了沿着绳索旋转并发出独特鸣响。晃得越有力，旋转越快、声音越响；完整旋转一圈，功德 +1。 竹知了是一款以传统民间发声玩具为灵感制作的互动 App。 真实的竹知了通过挥动手柄，让玩具沿绳索旋转并发出独特鸣响。现在，你可以在 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 上重新体验这份简单、有趣的童年快乐。 主要玩法： 点击屏幕或晃动设备，让竹知了开始旋转 连续点击或持续晃动，可以不断加速 晃动力度越大，旋转速度和声音强度越高 停止操作后，竹知了会自然减速，并在重力作用下回到绳子最低处 支持顺时针与逆时针旋转 每完整旋转一圈，功德 +1 功德数字保存在设备本地，可以持续累计 支持 Apple Watch： iPhone 与 Apple Watch 均可独立运行。即使不打开手机，也可以直接在手表上点击或晃动，感受竹知了旋转和发声。 简单而纯粹： 无广告 无需注册账号 无用户追踪 无需联网，随时可以游玩 iPhone 与 Apple Watch 的功德分别保存在各自设备上 晃一晃，让熟悉的竹声再次响起。

6755929376.description: NaNa拼单词学英语是一款专为英语学习者设计的拼写游戏应用。通过有趣的字母排序游戏，帮助用户轻松记忆单词，提升英语拼写能力。 核心功能 三级难度挑战 简单模式：仅包含单词字母，适合初学者快速上手 困难模式：增加干扰字母，提升挑战难度 地狱模式：高难度挑战，10秒倒计时，考验反应速度 丰富词库系统 小学词库：适合初学者，基础词汇学习 初中词库：扩展词汇量，巩固基础 高中词库：进阶学习，提升水平 四级词库：大学英语四级核心词汇 自定义词库：支持导入个人词库，个性化学习 智能学习系统 智能选词：优先推荐未掌握单词，避免重复 掌握进度：实时显示各词库掌握情况 历史记录：记录所有答题历史，随时回顾 语音播放：标准发音，帮助正确学习 游戏化体验 积分系统：不同难度不同积分，激励持续学习 成就系统：12种成就等你解锁，记录学习里程碑 连续答对：追踪连续答对次数，挑战自我 统计数据：详细记录各难度正确率和答题情况 个性化设置 语音开关：开启或关闭单词发音 音效开关：游戏音效自由控制 震动反馈：答题反馈更直观 主题模式：支持浅色深色模式，护眼舒适 完美适配 支持iPhone和iPad全系列设备 适配各种屏幕尺寸 流畅的游戏体验 简洁美观的界面设计 适用人群 英语学习者：从小学到大学，各阶段都适用 单词记忆困难者：通过游戏化方式轻松记忆 想要提升拼写能力者：系统训练拼写技能 喜欢挑战者：地狱模式等你来战 立即下载，开始你的英语学习之旅。通过有趣的拼写游戏，让单词记忆变得轻松愉快。

6760777178.name: Film Light
6760777178.description: Film Light，做你口袋里的专业数字测光表！适用于胶片摄影、影视灯光。 基于场景参考(Scene-Referred)的专业摄影测光表 APP。基于 Apple Log 色彩管线，高效测光，精准预览。独创的拟物风拨盘测光 UI，可快速进行光圈优先，快门优先以及手动曝光预览模式切换。内置经典胶片模拟LUT，亦可自定义导入 .cube 文件。支持近 1 度精准点测、智能矩阵测光。便捷的曝光补偿、ND 滤镜计算。 不止是测光表，更是你的摄影日志。内置相册功能，支持项目与胶卷管理；相册可查看 EV 点表、随时切换 LUT 预览，让每一次曝光决策都留有记录。 机型要求： iPhone 15 Pro 及后续支持 Apple Log 的机型可获得完整体验。在不支持 Apple Log 的机型上，Film Light 将以 HLG 模式运行；由于该模式下的画面经过局部影调映射（LTM），任意移动取样点后的读数无法保证准确，因此自定义 EV 点表结果并不准确。

6757110615.name: WRhythm
6757110615.description: WRhythm is a WatchOS app and optional iOS companion app to help you take your music library on the go! The flow is: (1) host your music on your server with any app (like Navidrome) that implements the Subsonic API (2) connect your watch (or iphone) to the server (3) stream or download your tracks without needing to keep your iPhone nearby High level features include: Stream your music library directly on your Watch or phone. Download track, albums, favorites, or playlists from your music collection to your Watch or phone. Don't have any playlists? Use the play similar songs feature to generate your own! Offline mode is available for when you're on the go with your watch, or on the plane with your phone, and only want access to tracks that are stored locally Technical Features: If you have the watch tethered to your iPhone that is running Tailscale, streaming to your watch over Tailscale will work out of the box Works with any server-side music streaming app that implements the Subsonic API (https://www.subsonic.org) such as Navidrome or Gonic IMPORTANT: WRhythm is a client-only application. No music is provided by this app. You must have purchased music and hosted it on your own subsonic compatible music server to stream music. WRhythm is an independent project and is not affiliated with the official Subsonic or Navidrome developers.

6794661401.name: 频闪检测仪 - 光源闪烁测量仪、PWM 测试
6794661401.trackName: 频闪检测仪 - 光源闪烁测量仪、PWM 测试
6794661401.description: 台灯、护眼灯、LED 灯泡、电脑显示器、手机屏幕——它们发出的光看起来稳定，实际上可能存在肉眼难以察觉的亮度波动（频闪）。 长时间在频闪光环境下用眼，容易引起疲劳、眼胀、头痛甚至眩晕。 这款 App 帮你发现人眼难以察觉的闪烁。 【快速测频闪】 对准光源或屏幕，App 会持续采集约 3 秒自适应多快门样本，并实时更新"有无频闪"的筛查结论。 筛查结论：检测到频闪 / 未检测到明显频闪 / 暂无法判断 护眼判断：基于频闪水平给出低 / 中 / 高风险提示 专业参数：频闪指数、调制深度、主频、亮度波形图 【不止检测频闪】 环境照度估算：给出大致亮度区间，帮你判断环境是否适合用眼。 色温估算：大致色温参考。 护眼判断：结合频闪水平给出低 / 中 / 高风险提示。 【导出与分享】 生成 PDF 报告（含波形图、频谱图、光源截图与结论），或导出 CSV 原始数据。 【隐私优先，完全离线】 不含广告、不集成任何分析 SDK、不需要账号。 App 不主动联网，所有数据只存在你的设备上。 测量过程生成的视频仅临时处理，分析完成后立即删除；App 只保留测量结果和备注信息。 可随时在"设置"中一键清除全部本地数据。 【支持 12 种语言】 简体中文、繁體中文、English、日本語、한국어、Français、Deutsch、Español、Português、Русский、العربية、हिन्दी。 【重要说明】 本 App 提供的是消费级光环境筛查，结果受手机相机帧率、曝光、滚动快门和环境光影响，不能替代专业光度计检测、标准合规认证或医疗诊断。 隐私政策：https://wwmmkk.github.io/Flicker-Insight/Privacy%20Policy 使用条款（EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6746176540.name: Dijon: The Owl's Trail
6746176540.description: Lace up your walking shoes and get ready to explore! Dijon: The Owl's Trail is your guide to the historic capital of Burgundy, home to nearly a thousand years of art, architecture, and culture. Discover four distinct walking tours that will introduce you to the best of this unique city. You'll discover a palace that houses a world-class art collection, towers that have silently stood guard over a changing city, and historic churches, including one that is known for its good luck charm! You'll also discover the city's rich collection of museums, including archaeological centers, art galleries, and a museum dedicated to life in one of the world's best known wine regions. If you get lost, the app will help you find your way, so you can take on the town with confidence. Enjoy all Dijon has to offer - it's more than mustard!

6793995232.name: 寻天
6793995232.description: 寻天 是一款面向专业天文观测场景的离线工具，用于计算天体位置并模拟望远镜真实视场，而非娱乐型星空浏览应用。 天文爱好者在野外观测时，经常遇到两个高频痛点：偏远山区、高原、沙漠等观测点没有蜂窝网络，无法快速获知目标天体的方位与高度角；深空天体在望远镜视场中的大小差异巨大，无法提前判断望远镜 + 目镜组合能否把目标完整纳入视场。 寻天 在完全离线的环境下解决这两个问题。它内置亮星、梅西耶与精选 NGC 天体数据库，通过本地算法计算天体地平坐标，并基于你输入的望远镜和目镜参数，绘制真实视场圆叠加在目标附近参考星图上，帮助你在实际观测前完成构图规划。 核心功能： 离线天体数据库：300+ 亮星、110 个梅西耶天体、30 个精选 NGC 天体 本地计算天体地平坐标（方位角 / 高度角），支持未来 72 小时内任意时刻 望远镜 + 目镜真实视场模拟，判断深空天体是否完整入框 非 AR 观测罗盘，通过陀螺仪与指南针辅助指向目标 观测计划清单，按最佳观测时间排序并追踪完成状态 最佳观测窗口计算：升起 / 落下 / 上中天、月相干扰、晨昏影时间 相机传感器视场模拟，服务天文摄影构图 寻星路径（Star Hopping）：从亮星逐级跳转到暗弱目标 自定义目标输入：手动输入 RA / Dec 或导入临时目标 夜间红光模式，保护暗适应 寻天 不使用摄像头、不加载在线内容、不渲染全天星空，所有计算均在本地完成，适用于野外观测、天文教学与深空摄影场景。

6779430459.name: 席卡桌牌打印助手2026
6779430459.description: 席卡桌牌打印助手是一款面向行政、会务、婚礼筹备和培训组织者的离线排版工具。用户可在本地录入姓名、单位、桌号或座位信息，快速生成可打印的席卡、桌牌、名牌版式，并导出PDF用于普通打印机打印。 应用适合临时会务、公司会议、培训签到、婚宴排桌、论坛嘉宾席、课堂分组等需要快速制作桌面名牌的场景。所有名单、桌号和排版方案都保存在设备本地，不需要登录账号，不联网，不收集或上传用户数据。 主要功能： 1. 席卡与桌牌模板：提供横版、竖版、对折、双面显示等常用版式，可调整A4纸张、边、字号、字体粗细和对齐方式。 2. 名单与桌号管理：本地录入姓名、单位、职务、桌号、座位备注，支持批量复制粘贴、快速搜索、分组筛选和编号排序。 3. 打印预览与PDF导出：实时预览每页排版结果，自动分页，提示纸张余量与溢出内容，可导出PDF保存、分享或打印。 4. 方案复用：保存不同会议、培训、宴席项目的排版方案，后续可复制模板并替换名单。

6794654752.name: 回看 · 我的影像
6794654752.description: 相册不该只是一张越积越长的清单。 回看会把你的照片和视频分成一小组一小组，随机带你重新翻看。你可以留下喜欢的、收藏重要的、回到时间线看看那一刻前后发生了什么；想删除的内容会先集中展示，确认后才交给系统相册处理。 照片左右翻，视频上下刷；也可以把照片和视频混在一起，像回顾自己的记忆流一样慢慢整理。 你会喜欢的功能 照片、视频、照片与视频混合三种浏览模式 每组随机抽取，避免组内和相邻轮次重复 照片左右翻看；视频与混合模式上下浏览 视频自动播放、循环、可暂停、长按 2 倍速、可拖动进度 Live Photo 自动播放，长按重新播放 删除前展示待删除缩略图，统一确认 查看当前内容前后时间线 收藏、分享，以及将照片旋转同步回系统相册 仅在本机处理：没有账号、没有上传、没有追踪

6790749496.name: 投屏·阿西西
6790749496.description: 让画面，自在抵达。 投屏·阿西西可将你的 iPhone 或 iPad 变成便携的投屏接收屏，在同一局域网内接收来自 iPhone、iPad、Mac 及其他兼容 AirPlay 发送设备的画面与声音。 你还可以连接同一局域网内的兼容 Apple TV。完成配对后，可在本机查看 Apple TV 画面，并使用内置遥控器完成方向选择、确认、返回、主屏幕、播放/暂停和静音等常用操作。 连接兼容的 AR 眼镜或外接显示器后，可通过“显示器模式”将画面输出到外接屏幕，本机继续用于操作和打开投屏菜单。支持在兼容显示模式下实时将普通 2D 画面转换为 Full-SBS 或 Half-SBS 3D，并提供柔和、标准、强烈三档景深效果。 主要功能： 接收局域网内的无线镜像画面与声音 支持 1080p 与 4K 接收分辨率选项 提供系统渲染与 Metal 渲染模式 将画面输出到兼容的 AR 眼镜或外接显示器 实时将 2D 画面转换为 Full-SBS 或 Half-SBS 3D 提供柔和、标准、强烈三档 3D 景深效果 外接显示时保留本机操作与投屏菜单 随时静音或恢复本机声音播放 点击画面进入全屏查看 一键截取当前画面并保存到系统照片 录制画面与可用声音并保存到系统照片 可选择 30 或 60 帧作为录制目标 查看分辨率、帧率、画面与声音状态 发现、配对并连接兼容 Apple TV 使用简洁的内置 Apple TV 遥控器 自动保存配对状态，也可忘记设备后重新配对 内置设置帮助，快速了解连接、渲染、录制和遥控功能 渲染与显示： 系统渲染优先兼容性与功耗表现；Metal 渲染支持外接显示器画面处理和实时 2D 转 3D。渲染模式与接收分辨率的修改会在下一次投屏时生效。 实时 2D 转 3D 需要 iOS 17 或更高版本、Metal 渲染，以及兼容的 AR 眼镜或外接显示设备。可用的 Full-SBS 或 Half-SBS 格式取决于外接设备报告的显示模式。 隐私与本地处理： 投屏流量仅在本地网络中传输，画面、声音及 2D 转 3D 深度分析均在本机处理。 诊断日志默认关闭。开启后，仅在本机保存经脱敏的连接与画面状态，不保留设备身份、端口或认证数据；关闭后会清空已保存的诊断日志。 截图与录屏仅在获得系统照片权限后保存。 使用提示： 发送设备与本机需要连接到同一局域网 4K 会增加网络带宽和设备处理压力，最终接收分辨率与帧率仍由发送设备决定 实际画面、声音、遥控及外接显示能力取决于发送设备、系统版本和网络环境 不同设备型号、AR 眼镜、显示器及系统版本的兼容性可能有所差异 请仅对你拥有或已获授权的内容进行截图和录制 本应用为独立开发的第三方工具，未经 Apple Inc. 授权、赞助或认可，与 Apple Inc. 不存在隶属关系。 Apple、Apple TV 和 AirPlay 是 Apple Inc. 的商标。

6742354555.name: FAC Clipper
6742354555.description: Enhances Mix Loudness and Adds Harmonic Warmth Full-Band and Two-Band Clipper in a Single Plugin Quick, lightweight, and designed for effortless flexibility! Precise Visual Metering for Fast Peak Control Knee Curve Adjustment, from Super Soft to Hard Shape Control of the Harmonic Profile Dry/Wet Mix for a Natural, Balanced Sound Low Latency with Optional Oversampling Advanced Responsive Design, portrait and landscape views Universal Purchase: AUv3 for iOS (iPad/iPhone), macOS and Vision Pro FAC Clipper is designed to enhance your mix's loudness and add signature harmonic warmth. While it is based on a similar DSP architecture to the Clip processor in FAC Punchlab, it takes a different approach to clipping control, featuring an advanced user interface with precise metering to track and manage the peaks of the audio signal. The plugin also includes both a full-band clipper that processes the entire spectrum and a multi-band clipper, allowing you to independently clip low, high, or both frequency bands. This provides the flexibility to maintain transparent processing or experiment with creative adjustments, depending on your needs. Built with simplicity and flexibility in mind, FAC Clipper is quick, lightweight, and highly intuitive. The clean, streamlined interface lets you focus on what matters most; controlling the peak levels to maximize loudness while preserving clarity and avoiding the pumping effects often associated with heavily limited signals. Thanks to its precise waveform and level meters, using FAC Clipper is a breeze. Simply add the plugin to your track and adjust the input gain until the waveform meter reaches 0 dB. This gives you a clear view of the signal's dynamic range, making it easier to identify peaks. Next, set the ceiling just below the peaks you wish to control. You can also adjust the Knee parameter for smoother clipping and fine-tune the saturation to achieve the perfect warmth and character. Use the Mix parameter to blend the clipped signal with the original audio, allowing you to control the amount of clipping applied. This helps preserve the natural character of the sound while enhancing loudness and harmonic warmth. This is an AUv3 Effect and requires a compatible host to work The documentation is available at fredantoncorvest.com/FAC_Clipper.html

6753187058.name: Quartet 6
6753187058.description: Practice and perform jazz standards on another level with Quartet – the top-selling live jazz standards play along app. Volume 6 includes another 100 stunning jazz standards recorded by 5 of the world’s best jazz musicians exclusively for Quartet. All live studio recordings with intros and endings. Whether you play jazz piano, guitar, saxophone, trumpet, bass, drums…simply mute your instrument from the Quartet for the ultimate jazz play along. And for jazz singers too, each edition of Quartet is an unrivalled collection of jazz backing tracks powerful enough to gig with. Change key on the fly. Speed up or slow down the audio seamlessly using the very latest audio technology. Loop sections and slow them right down for practice. Improve your skills with full screen animated chord diagrams for Piano, Guitar and Ukulele. Search all 650 songs in the Quartet song library and build multi-app playlists using any of the songs from any of the 6 editions of Quartet that you own. Playlists are automated and auto-sync across each of your Quartet apps. And now you can export either the stereo mix or the original multitrack free of charge. Remix or develop the separated parts in GarageBand or whatever DAW you use. Quartet content is offered to you royalty-free, giving you endless creative possibilities. Quartet Volume 6 includes jazz improvisations in the style of… ‘Afternoon in Paris’, ‘Ain’t She Sweet’, ‘All The Things You Are’ (3/4 and 5/4), ‘Autumn Leaves’ (3/4, 7/4 and Bossa), ‘Epistrophy’, ‘Giant Steps’ (Bossa), ‘Groovin’ High’, ‘I Got Rhythm’ (Latin), ‘Let’s Get Lost’, ‘Mas Que Nada’, ‘Milestones’, ‘Mo’ Better Blues’, ‘One For My Baby’, ‘Stormy Monday’, ‘Tricotism’, ‘Try a Little Tenderness’, 'Vivo Sonhando’ plus 80 more songs! Install Quartet on all of your iOS devices plus your Mac (M- series only) at no extra cost. Quartet. Take your jazz standards play along to another level! Hear more at www.quartetapp.com Featured artists Guitar Nigel Price A former member of The James Taylor Quartet, Nigel was voted the UK’s ‘Best Guitarist’ in the 2016 British Jazz Awards. “Probably the most dynamic and gifted guitarist on the British jazz scene today” [All About Jazz]. Nigel has recorded on over 50 albums, most recently with Van Morrison. Saxophone /Flute Andy Panayi Credits include Sir Paul McCartney, Seth MacFarlane, Elvis Costello, Georgie Fame, Freddie Hubbard, Wynton Marsalis, Joe Lovano, Roy Hargrove… Piano Graham Harvey Credits include Incognito (MD), Stacey Kent, George Benson, M People, Chaka Khan, The BBC Big Band, Madeline Bell, Jocelyn Brown, Mica Paris, Sir Cliff Richard… Bass Geoff Gascoyne Credits include Jamie Cullum (MD), Sting, Van Morrison, Bill Bruford, Mari Wilson, Paloma Faith, Georgie Fame, Gloria Estefan, Guy Barker, Charlie Watts, Everything But The Girl, Benny Golson, Jacqui Dankworth, Bob Dorough, John Martyn, Dianne Reeves, Eartha Kitt… Drums Sebastiaan de Krom Credits include Herbie Hancock, John Scofield, Phil Woods, Dave Holland, Jamie Cullum, Guy Barker, Wynton Marsalis, Tim Garland’s Big Band, Steve Watts...

6782311773.name: LocoPast: The History Map
6782311773.description: Something incredible happened where you're standing right now. We built LocoPast because we kept wondering about the places around us. Every street, building, coastline and landscape has a story, but discovering those stories often meant searching through books, articles and websites. LocoPast is a way to open a map and instantly see the history beneath your feet. LocoPast is the location-based history map app. We transform the world into an interactive map of human history. Open the app and discover the battles, revolutions, inventions, disasters, cultural movements, scandals and forgotten stories that happened exactly where you're standing - or anywhere else on Earth. History isn't just something that happened somewhere else. It's all around us. Whether you're exploring your local area, travelling abroad, or simply curious about a place you've never visited, LocoPast reveals the events that shaped the landscapes, cities and communities we see today. With LocoPast, you can: Discover historical events near your current location Explore any place in the world Browse a global, interactive history map Listen to hands-free audio guides of each historical event or site Travel through centuries of events connected to real locations Open source articles for deeper context and further reading Every event is linked to the place where it happened, turning ordinary locations into gateways to the past. As you move across the map, new stories appear automatically, creating a continuous journey of discovery. Explore events including: Battles and military history Art, culture and creative movements Political events and revolutions Scientific discoveries and innovation Architecture and landmarks Religion and belief systems Crime, scandals and mysteries Natural disasters and major world events Industry, commerce and economic history The next time you look at a street, a square, a river or a landmark, you'll know something most people don't: What happened there. Download LocoPast and uncover the hidden history of the world around you.

6759207345.name: Feed Filter for Twitter
6759207345.description: Feed Filter for Twitter lets you hide or flag tweets on your timeline using custom rules. You write conditions based on tweet content or account properties -- things like follower count, account age, whether a tweet contains links, or if the username matches a pattern. Matched tweets can be hidden entirely or visually dimmed with a label showing which rule triggered. The rule language supports comparisons, string matching, regex, and basic logic operators. A few preset rules for common cases (crypto spam, suspicious accounts) are included and can be toggled on or off. Other features: Import CSV lists (e.g. from Twitter Exporter) and reference them in rules with in_list() Export and import rules as JSON to share with others A stats page showing how many tweets were scanned, marked, or hidden, broken down by rule Global toggle to enable or disable all filtering Default action setting (mark or hide) that individual rules can inherit or override The extension runs entirely in your browser. No data is sent anywhere.

6761081919.name: TrimrPix
6761081919.description: I built TrimrPix to do one thing well. It makes the photos in your iPhone library smaller, and it replaces the originals in place. There is no duplicate album to clean up afterwards, nothing is uploaded, and it needs no internet connection. Most photo compressors save a smaller copy and leave the original behind, so you end up sorting out a "Compressed" album by hand. TrimrPix replaces the photo directly in your library instead. Pick your photos, choose your settings, slide to confirm. One-time purchase. $1.99, no subscription, no ads, no tracking. TWO WAYS TO COMPRESS Quality: Same, Good, or Smaller Target size: set a per-photo limit (500 KB, 1 MB, 2 MB, or 5 MB) and TrimrPix finds the quality that fits FORMATS JPEG, PNG, WebP, and HEIC Each photo keeps its original format METADATA CONTROL Keep or remove date and time Strip GPS location Remove camera settings, copyright info, or Apple data You decide what stays and what goes PRIVATE BY DEFAULT Everything happens on your device No internet connection required No cloud, no accounts, no sign-ups The only data collected is anonymous crash reports WORKS WITH ICLOUD iCloud photos are downloaded, compressed, and saved back Compressing replaces your originals and cannot be undone, so TrimrPix shows the estimated saving first and asks you to slide to confirm before anything changes. TrimrPix is open source. There is also a Mac version with a few extra features.

6504404183.name: Iconica Sketch - Orchestra app
6504404183.description: Your ultimate orchestra app for iPhone, iPad and every AU compatible mobile DAW Iconica Sketch brings the power of a full orchestra to your fingertips, offering top-tier audio quality and effortless simplicity. Whether you're crafting symphonies, scoring epic trailers, or producing chart-topping pop tracks, Iconica Sketch is designed to inspire and empower you – anywhere, anytime. Seamlessly integrate Iconica Sketch with your favorite mobile DAW, including Cubasis, Logic Pro for iPad, AUM, GarageBand and many more. Bring your musical ideas to life on the go with Iconica Sketch for iPhone and iPad. A complete orchestra for iPhone, iPad and every mobile DAW supporting AU 34 incredible-sounding instruments, ranging from violins to percussion 140 of the most important short and long articulations (including legatos) Recorded at the legendary Funkhaus Berlin, in cooperation with Orchestral Tools Includes free additional Cubasis plug-in version for improved integration and maximum performance A complete orchestra for iPhone and iPad Iconica Sketch pairs a full orchestra with portability and ease of use, but without compromising on audio quality. Capture great ideas on the move, right there on your iPhone and iPad. And it’s fully-compatible with your AU-compatible DAW. Easy to use and ready when inspiration strikes Iconica Sketch is designed to offer both simplicity and depth, making it easily accessible for beginners and pros alike. Capture and develop ideas quickly, or create full orchestral arrangements whenever inspiration strikes. Dynamics view Get an instant, real-time view of the dynamic range your orchestral instrument is playing in. Switch between articulations Seamlessly switch between a vast array of an instrument’s articulations with a single click or via keyswitch. From delicate legatos to powerful staccatos, you can effortlessly create dynamic, authentic arrangements, thanks to a great selection of the most common articulations for each instrument. Adaptive True Legato Iconica uses an Adaptive True Legato System, which intelligently adjusts to your playing speed, ensuring a seamless, truly expressive and authentic performance. Free Cubasis plug-in version Take your music creation to the next level with our multi-award winning Cubasis mobile DAW, now featuring support for tempo, signature track and much more. As the owner of Cubasis and Iconica Sketch for iPhone and iPad, you get a free additional Cubasis plug-in version of the instrument for improved integration and maximum performance. You can also use Iconic Sketch on its own, or within every mobile DAW that supports Audio Units. Always ready when inspiration strikes Iconica Sketch puts an entire orchestra at your fingertips. Whether you're on your iPhone or iPad, you'll have a full range of instruments ready to play on their own or within every AU-compatible mobile DAW, ensuring you never miss a moment of inspiration. Compose and arrange with ease, all from the palm of your hand. Iconica Sketch is compact in size, fast to load, easy to use and features high-quality, detailed recordings from the Orchestral Tools Iconica library, designed to effortlessly produce modern, cinematic scores or enhance modern pop tracks. Take Iconica Sketch with you wherever you go, and let your ideas flow freely, no matter when and where creativity strikes. Technical support https://forums.steinberg.net If you like Iconica Sketch, please support us by rating this app in the App Store! Thank you!

6789291126.name: AlbumDeck：3D 专辑封面
6789291126.description: 还记得站在自己的 CD 架前是什么感觉吗？AlbumDeck 把这种感觉带回你的 iPhone 和 iPad。 你的资料库变成一个由 CD 盒组成的 3D 旋转列表——带铰链、盒边、光泽与倒影。两侧的封面向中间倾斜，正是经典封面浏览的模样。一张张翻看，轻点中间那张，盒子便翻转过来，露出背面的曲目列表。轻点某首歌即可播放。 AlbumDeck 是为你已有资料库打造的新界面：播放由 Apple 的"音乐"App 完成，因此设备上必须安装该 App。AlbumDeck 本身不是流媒体服务，也无需订阅，它只显示你已经拥有的音乐。 功能 逼真 CD 盒的 3D 旋转列表——也可选择平面封面 经典封面浏览的观感：两侧封面向中间倾斜 轻点翻面：背面即曲目列表，挑选歌曲 大资料库也从容:用字母索引条直接跳到旋转列表中的目标位置,用筛选只显示特定艺人的专辑 通过系统播放器播放——离开 App 音乐照常继续 支持你的资料库，包括你添加的 Apple Music 内容 长专辑名以滚动文字显示，内置播放控制 竖屏与横屏，iPhone 与 iPad 皆可 内置示例专辑，没有自己的音乐也能体验 隐私 AlbumDeck 不收集任何数据。无账户、无广告、无跟踪——你的数据永远不会到达我们这里。

6762268475.name: HALion Sonic Play: Workstation
6762268475.description: Your go-to workstation instrument app for iPhone, iPad, and every AUv3-compatible mobile DAW HALion Sonic Play for iPhone and iPad brings the spirit of a full-blown workstation to your mobile setup; packed with more than 2,000 exceptional instrument sounds spanning every genre. From modern synths and punchy basses to expressive keys, pads, leads, and beyond, HALion Sonic Play is built to help you create finished, professional tracks fast — wherever inspiration hits. Whether you’re sketching ideas on the couch, building beats on the train, or polishing a full arrangement in the studio, HALion Sonic Play fits right in. Use it standalone for instant playability, or run it inside Cubasis and any AUv3-compatible DAW on iPhone and iPad for a seamless production workflow. Your workstation instrument for iPhone, iPad, and every AUv3-compatible mobile DAW More than 2,000 inspiring instrument sounds — ready for every genre Quick Controls to shape and tweak sounds in seconds — no deep diving Arpeggiator for instant motion, rhythm, and modern patterns Quick ADSR controls for precise, musical envelope control Works standalone or inside Cubasis and any AUv3-compatible DAW on iPhone and iPad Your sound, always within reach HALion Sonic Play is designed for speed, creativity, and great sound from the very first tap. Open the app and you’re immediately surrounded by a huge range of playable instruments, which can take you from a simple idea to a fully produced track in no time. Need movement? The arpeggiator brings instant energy and groove. Want to shape a sound quickly? Quick Controls and the ADSR page let you dial in punch, softness, brightness, or bite in seconds — so you stay in the flow. Whether you’re writing hooks, building chords, crafting textures, or laying down a full arrangement, HALion Sonic Play keeps things simple, musical, and fast, with all the depth you need for when you want to go further. Take your sound anywhere, start ideas instantly, and turn inspiration into standout tracks on iPhone and iPad. Technical support https://forums.steinberg.net If you like HALion Sonic Play, please support us by rating this app in the App Store! Thank you!

6792712229.name: Scribble Hunt
6792712229.description: 2–10 player online hide-and-seek. Sample colors, match the lighting, tune your materials — disguise yourself to perfection and slip away right under the Hunters' gaze. Bunnies were never born to hide ？ 2–10 players in one arena. Will you be the hunter, or the hunted? Hiders have two ways to survive: Scribble camouflage — sample colors, match the light, tune your materials, and paint yourself seamlessly into the scene; Shape-shifting — become any object in the environment, real enough to fool anyone. Hunters, meanwhile, carry high-tech paint weapons that leave no disguise unexposed. Super Bunny Man "Hide & Seek" The rules are simple. Split into the Hunter team and the Hider team and play hide-and-seek. The Hunters win if they find every Hider before time runs out. One-Tap Stamp · Master-Grade Camouflage More than color sampling — stamp the texture and finish of nearby materials onto yourself in one tap. No parameters, no painting skills. Even total beginners blend into the scene in an instant. Hunter's Arsenal · Paint Beats All The paint blaster fires precise shots — one splash of color and you're exposed. The splat bomb blankets a wide area, flushing out everyone in range. Pair them with the assault rifle to take down exposed targets on the spot. Maximum hunting efficiency. Super Matchmaking · Squad Up Open a private room and invite your friends, or hop into a public room and match with strangers. 2–10 players, one arena, endless fun!

6786893139.name: Wish Willow
6786893139.description: Make a wish. Break the Willow. Seal it. Wish Willow is a dark, atmospheric entertainment experience built around a mysterious wish ritual. Write your wish, read the warning, open the package, and break the Willow to seal what you asked for.Wish Willow turns a simple moment into something strange, memorable, and immersive. Best experienced with headphones in a quiet room. Features:** Write and seal a personal wish Open a Wish Willow package Break the wooden piece through an interactive ritual Designed for a dark, mysterious, story-like experience Wish Willow is for entertainment purposes only. Wishes are symbolic and fictional. After you complete the ritual and break the Willow, the experience is finished. Some sounds are intentionally dark, tense, and horror-inspired. Because of this, the app may not be suitable for children or very young users. 6744636363.description: The Macquarie Dictionary app provides users with the most up-to-date reference of Australian English, from the colourfully colloquial to the highly technical. Ad-free and with a fast and simple search, the app will help you find the word you need. Use the wildcard and suggestive search functions to expand your search or browse through all entries alphabetically. You can also bookmark words and view recent searches. Our comprehensive coverage of Australian English includes: 1. Over 275,000 definitions. 2. Over 184,000 headwords and phrases 3. Over 23,000 encyclopedic entries 4. Over 46,000 word origins or etymologies 5. IPA and plain English pronunciations for all entries. 6. Over 25,000 audio pronunciations voiced by real Australians* 7. Example phrases to show how a word is used 8. Regionalisms 9. Extensive usage notes OTHER FEATURES: Options to share entries and definitions. Access anytime without an internet connection Initial access to audio pronunciations and images requires internet connection. 6759353851.description: Punchy is a hands-free striking coach built for solo training. Start a session, hear the callouts, and stay focused on your movement, rhythm, and technique. Whether you train on the heavy bag or shadow box, Punchy helps you structure rounds, follow audio cues, and build consistency with clear, guided workouts. What you can do with Punchy: Follow real-time audio strike callouts during your rounds Train with Boxing, Kickboxing, and Muay Thai sessions Use quick-start presets or build your own custom workouts Adjust rounds, work/rest timing, stance, intensity, and strike selection Learn strikes step by step with guided practice Track your workout history and training totals Train offline without relying on a network connection Real-voice callouts: Punchy uses character-driven voice packs to make training feel alive. Choose from voices like Goku, Vegeta, and Kombat for clear, energetic strike callouts that bring more personality to every session. It is a distinctive part of the Punchy experience and gives your workouts a level of style and motivation that typical timer apps do not offer. Blends with your music: Punchy is designed to work alongside your music so your training flow does not get interrupted. Audio cues blend into your session while your own music keeps playing in the background, giving you guidance without forcing you to choose between coaching and your playlist. Built for real training: Punchy is designed for people who want a simple, focused training tool that works in the gym, at home, or wherever they train. The experience is built around fast access, clear structure, and audio-first coaching. 6767853168.name: Sobrium
6767853168.description: Sobrium keeps you in control of your phone when you're not in control of your judgment. Switch on Alcohol Mode before going out. The apps you'd regret using — Phone, Messages, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Instagram, Snapchat, anything you choose — get locked at the system level. Tap one and you'll see a shield: take a quick sobriety test to unlock everything for the duration you set. WHY SOBRIUM Most "drunk lock" apps are just a button you can disable in two taps. Sobrium uses Apple's Screen Time framework to lock apps the same way parental controls do — strong enough that even drunk-you can't easily bypass it. FOUR SOBRIETY TESTS Sobrium picks one at random when you try to unlock: Color Match — A reaction-time test based on the Stroop effect. The word "RED" appears in blue ink. Tap the color, not the word. Alcohol slows the brain's conflict-resolution; this is the strongest cognitive signal of impairment. Tap Rhythm — Watch a beat for a few seconds, then keep tapping the same tempo without the cue. The cerebellum handles timing precision, and alcohol hits it hard. Steady Trace — Drag your finger along a curved path. Measures fine motor control — the same skill roadside tests check. Stand Still — Hold the phone against your chest and balance on one leg. The accelerometer measures your sway, just like the police one-leg-stand test. SET YOUR OWN RULES Pick any combination of apps to block Three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard Unlock for 15 minutes, 30 minutes, or 1 hour at a time Choose which of the four tests to use, or enable all of them PRIVACY FIRST Sobrium runs entirely on your device. No accounts, no cloud, no tracking, no analytics. The app never sees what you're typing or who you're calling — it only knows whether the apps you chose are currently locked. TWELVE LANGUAGES Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, and Finnish. REQUIREMENTS iPhone with iOS 17 or later Screen Time / Family Controls permission (granted on first launch) A NOTE ON RESPONSIBILITY Sobrium is a behavioral tool, not a medical device. It cannot measure your blood alcohol level — it measures coordination, reaction, and balance, all of which alcohol affects. If you're impaired, please don't drive. Call a cab, call a friend, get home safe.

6794602959.name: 消控题库
6794602959.description: 消控题库是一款面向消防设施操作员（初级 / 五级）「基础知识」备考的模拟练习工具，面向消防控制室值班、消防设施操作维保等持证上岗人群。 【为什么选消控题库】 一次买断，无广告、无内购 全程离线，随时刷 426 道模拟练习题，覆盖消防工作概述与法规、燃烧基础、建筑防火、火灾自动报警系统、水灭火系统、其他灭火系统、消防供配电与控制室、初起火灾处置、消防安全管理等考纲板块 独家消防速查：闭式喷头色标温度（红 68℃ 等）、关键消防数字（防火门、防火阀、手报间距、应急照明…）、消防控制室值班与应急处置、火灾分类速查 10 章系统知识课 + 速记卡，先学后练 【刷题体验】 顺序 / 随机 / 章节专练；模拟考试按真实题型（单选 + 多选 + 判断）配比组卷、计时判分；错题本 + 智能复习；每题详解标注国家标准 / 规范依据。 本应用为消防设施操作员（初级）基础知识备考工具，不含注册消防工程师内容；2026 版国家职业标准自 2026-10-01 起施行，如遇新旧版交替以发证机关 / 当地鉴定站最新规定为准。 本应用为第三方自研备考辅助工具，题库为依据公开国家职业技能标准与官方教材编写校准的模拟练习题，非考试真题；与人力资源社会保障部、应急管理部 / 国家消防救援局及任何官方考试 / 鉴定机构无隶属或授权关系，不含任何官方标识。一次买断，无广告无内购，全程离线，不收集任何个人数据。

6779569622.description: 山野-海拔气压是一款面向徒步、露营、登山和自驾进山场景的离线户外环境工具。 它把海拔、气压、指南针、坐标、日出日落和月相等常用信息集中在一个应用里，尽量做到打开就能看、弱网也能用。 适合这些人使用： 徒步、登山、露营用户 自驾进山、越野、钓鱼用户 摄影打卡和海拔记录用户 偏好无广告、买断制、本地工具的用户 主要功能： 当前海拔与相对高度查看 环境气压与气压趋势参考 指南针方向与坡度辅助 经纬度与本地坐标信息查看 日出日落、月出月落与月相参考 收藏地点、历史记录与本地设置保存 产品特点： 离线可用 无广告 无订阅 无需注册 数据默认保存在本机

6751501196.name: 智懂记尊享版:AI驱动的全自动记账工具
6751501196.trackName: 智懂记尊享版:AI驱动的全自动记账工具
6751501196.description: 智懂记---让记账自动化、分析智能化 【2.0.0 新功能：AI 语音账本助手——开口即可记账】 长按首页 logo 唤起 AI 助手，语音对话式记账，告别手动输入； 智能识别消费内容并自动归类入账，支持多维度账单分析与语音播报； 【全自动记账系统：告别手动录入，账单自动 "归位"】 邮件账单解析： 支持识别银行流水、电商平台（如购物、出行）等各类邮件账单，自动提取 日期、交易金额、商家名称、收支类型 等核心信息。 示例：收到 "招商银行交易流水" 邮件，系统自动解析每笔交易，同步记入对应账户。 消费短信抓取： 收到银行扣款、快捷支付等交易短信，智能提取 时间、金额、交易对象（如 "XX 超市""XX 加油站"），自动归类记账。 示例：收到 "招行信用卡消费 9.98 元" 短信，系统识别为 "养卡" 支出（结合历史分类学习），自动记入账单。 自动化流程： 无需手动操作，账单 / 短信触发后，系统自动完成 记账、分类、关联账户 ，大幅节省时间，避免漏记、错记。 【AI 智能分类引擎：懂消费的 "财务大脑"】 多维度自动分类： 不仅区分 消费大类（如 "日常用品""交通""学习"），还细化 交易对象、交易员、受益人、项目标签（如 "打车→XX 平台→本人→通勤"）。 示例：购买书籍的消费，自动归类为 "书籍（学习）→京东→本人→自我提升"，维度更丰富。 动态学习优化： 基于用户历史消费数据，AI 持续学习分类偏好（如 "每月 10 号的 9.98 元固定归为'养卡'"），越用越贴合个人消费习惯。 【多维度账单分析：从宏观到细节，财务脉络全掌握】 可视化报表体系： 资产 / 负债：饼图展示房产、存款、信用卡等占比，清晰呈现资产结构； 收入 / 支出：圆环图解析消费分布（如 "日常用品占 49.65%""打车占 20.34%"），收支构成一目了然。 趋势追踪图表： 按月 / 年生成 柱形趋势图（如资产增减、支出波动），直观对比不同周期的财务变化（示例：2025 年 3-8 月资产趋势，快速发现增长 / 下降节点）。 细粒度维度筛选： 支持按 消费大类 / 细类、交易对象、渠道 等维度筛选分析（如 "查看'书籍'类支出的月度变化，或'微信支付'渠道的所有消费"），深入挖掘消费规律。 【支出预算管理：科学规划，理性消费】 多维度预算设置： 支持按 消费大类、细类、账本等维度灵活设置预算（如 "每月'交通'类预算 500 元"），精准控制各项支出。 示例：设置 "日常用品" 月度预算 2000 元，系统实时追踪实际支出，超支时及时提醒。 预算执行监控： 实时展示 预算总额、已用金额、剩余额度、执行率 等关键指标（如 "本月预算 5000 元，已用 3200 元，剩余 1800 元，执行率 64%"），消费进度一目了然。 支持 预算预警机制：当支出接近或超过预算时，系统自动提醒（如 "本月'交通'类支出已达预算的 90%，请注意控制"），帮助及时调整消费计划。 预算分析报表： 生成 预算执行对比图表（如柱状图展示预算 vs 实际支出），直观呈现各维度预算执行情况； 支持 历史预算对比分析（如 "对比近 3 个月预算执行趋势"），发现消费规律，优化预算设置。 灵活预算调整： 支持 预算的创建、编辑、删除 等操作，可根据实际情况动态调整（如 "临时增加'学习'类预算 500 元"），预算管理更灵活。 【账单记录分类管理：场景化记账更高效】 四大账单类型覆盖： 邮件账：集中管理银行、平台的邮件账单，可追溯原始凭证； 短信账：汇总交易短信记录，快速核对实时消费； 周期账：设置固定支出 / 收入（如月租、工资），按周期（日 / 周 / 月）自动生成记账记录； 模板账：保存常用消费模板（如 "书籍 - 微信支付 - 学习"），下次消费一键调用，减少重复操作。 周期账智能设置： 支持 按工作日、自然日、自定义周期 配置（如 "每个工作日的'四餐'支出"），生效后自动记账，覆盖固定开销场景。 模板账灵活创建： 自定义 金额、分类、支付渠道、备注 等信息（如 "书籍 - 21.50 元 - 微信 - 买新书"），适合高频、固定场景的快速记账。 【账本与账户管理中心：全局掌控财务状态】 多账本灵活管理： 支持创建 个人、家庭、项目 等多账本，独立管理收支（如 "家庭账本" 记录共同消费，"项目账" 追踪副业收入）； 支持账本的 创建、编辑、删除 ，数据隔离更清晰。 账户余额实时监控： 汇总银行卡、微信、现金等账户余额，展示 总资产、净资产、负债 占比（如 "房产占 50.85%，负债占 71.9%"），全局财务状态一目了然。

6751219483.name: 浮图说-照片回忆助手
6751219483.description: 浮图说 / Rephoto，是一款让旧照片重新浮现的App。 相册里有几千、几万张照片，但我们很少主动翻回去看。 浮图说不是帮你整理分类，而是帮你重新遇见那些沉在相册深处的画面。 【浮图说】发现照片之间的颜色、构图、时间和人物呼应。 【当时今日】看看去年的、前年的、很多年前的今天。 【照片日历】用动态日历查看本月拍照分布，看见一整月的生活痕迹。 【随便看看】随机抽取旧照片。喜欢就收藏，不需要也可以顺手删除。 照片本地处理、无需上传识图。 无广告、无内购，简洁沉浸。

6756945207.name: 灵动通讯录-纯本地不联网
6756945207.trackName: 灵动通讯录-纯本地不联网
6756945207.description: 灵动通讯录 - 让联系人管理变得简单高效 您的通讯录是否因为重复联系人而混乱不堪？是否想快速访问常用联系人？灵动通讯录是一款专为 iOS 打造的智能通讯录管理工具，帮助您轻松整理、备份和管理联系人。 核心功能 【智能整理 - 告别重复混乱】 智能扫描：多维度识别重复联系人（姓名、电话、邮箱） 一键合并：保留完整信息，自动合并重复项 批量删除：快速清理无用联系人 可视化预览：合并前查看详细对比 【灵动岛快捷访问 】 联系人上岛：将常用联系人固定到灵动岛 一键拨号：点击即可快速呼叫 实时显示：联系人信息常驻展示 个性化设置：自定义点击行为 【时光机备份 - 数据安全无忧】 本地备份：定期自动备份通讯录 一键恢复：误删除也能快速找回 备份预览：恢复前查看备份详情 版本管理：支持多个备份版本 【工具箱 - 批量操作更高效】 Excel 导入：支持 .xlsx 格式批量导入 CSV 导入：兼容多种 CSV 格式 VCF 导入：标准通讯录格式支持 Excel 导出：联系人数据导出为表格 产品亮点 原生设计：遵循 iOS 设计规范，界面简洁美观 隐私安全：所有数据本地处理，不上传云端 性能优异：流畅操作，支持大量联系人处理 持续更新：不断优化功能，提升用户体验 适用场景 通讯录重复联系人太多，需要清理整理 换手机导入大量联系人，出现重复 需要快速访问常用联系人（家人、同事） 定期备份通讯录，防止数据丢失

6789963647.description: 骑行齿比是一款面向公路车、山地车、折叠车用户的离线齿比与踏频工具。用户可以保存多辆车的牙盘、飞轮、轮径配置，计算不同档位下的齿比、发展米、指定踏频速度，并对比更换飞轮或牙盘后的爬坡与巡航差异。适合想优化爬坡档位、规划训练踏频、改装传动系统的骑行爱好者一次性付费使用。所有数据仅保存在本机，不需要登录，不联网，不收集个人信息。

6702028512.name: FaceScreen: Floating Camera
6702028512.description: FaceScreen displays a floating live camera feed and an optional text label on top of everything else on your screen. Add a personal touch to your screen recordings, presentations, livestreams, and screen sharing sessions by keeping your face visible at all times. Use the built-in screen recorder on your phone or any third-party screen recording app. FaceScreen does not record, store, or process any video or personal data. It simply displays a customizable camera overlay on top of other apps and content. FEATURES Camera Single camera mode: A sleek camera overlay that floats above all other apps. Dual camera mode: Show both cameras at once with a draggable picture-in-picture front camera. Customize everything—from the camera shape and position to zoom level, size, orientation, and more. Zoom in when your camera is farther away for better visibility. Works seamlessly over apps running in full-screen mode. Drag and position the camera overlay anywhere on your screen. Your settings, including position, size, and appearance, are automatically saved for the next time you use FaceScreen. Text Showing your face is great, but if you're introducing yourself to a new audience, adding your name, website, or social media handle can make an even stronger impression. Customize the text content and its position to match your preferences. GETTING STARTED Install FaceScreen from the App Store Open FaceScreen and customize the camera view to your liking Leave FaceScreen running and switch to another app to display the floating camera view To hide the camera view, simply close FaceScreen USE CASES Video Reactions Tutorials & How-To Videos App Demos Presentations Screen Recordings Screen Sharing Livestreams Online Teaching Personal Branding CONTACT Website: facescreenapp.com X: @softal_io or @rampatra_ EXTRAS FAQ: facescreenapp.com/faq Privacy Policy: facescreenapp.com/privacy CREDITS Lucas Fischer

6764336056.name: 下一站NextStop
6764336056.description: NextStop 是一款轻量、安静的个人记录工具，用来保存那些还没有完全告别的人、物品和情绪。 你可以把一件物品、一个人或一段回忆放进站台，为它写下名称、备注和照片。等到真正准备放下时，再为它选择目的地并发车。NextStop 会把这些记录整理成清晰的站台、车票、后视镜和小组件，让告别不再只是突然删除，而是一个可以被看见、被完成的过程。 主要功能： 记录暂时舍不得放下的人或物 为每条记录添加备注、照片和分类 用“发车”完成一次告别 在后视镜中回看已经出发的记录 支持桌面 Widget 查看站台状态 支持 Live Activity 展示发车进程 支持 iCloud 在你的设备之间同步数据 NextStop 不追求复杂的清单管理，也不是社交产品。它更像一个私人站台：安静、克制，只服务于你自己的整理和告别。 适合这些场景： 想整理旧物，但不想立刻删除记忆 想记录一段关系或情绪的结束过程 想用更温和的方式完成断舍离 想把“放下”变成一个具体、可见的动作 你的记录默认保存在本地。若启用 iCloud，数据会通过 Apple CloudKit 同步到你的私人 iCloud 数据库中。

6791820112.name: 花光马斯克的钱

6738851786.name: Lingo Picture Match
6738851786.description: Lingo Picture Match – 通过图片学习词汇 通过快速、直观的视觉练习构建真正的词汇量。 Lingo Picture Match 是一款基于图片的语言学习游戏，旨在帮助您牢记单词。您无需死记硬背冗长的词汇表，而是将日常单词与清晰的图片联系起来，做出主动选择，并获得即时反馈。 简短的关卡、重复的接触和简单的玩法让学习变得自然且充满成就感。无论您有两分钟还是二十分钟，每一次练习都有助于加强您的识别、记忆和信心。 双向词汇训练 通过两种互补的游戏模式进行练习： 图片到单词 看图并选择正确的单词。 单词到图片 阅读单词并选择相匹配的图片。 双向训练不仅能帮助您识别词汇，还能帮助您在实际对话需要时快速检索并使用正确的单词。 按单元聚焦学习 词汇被组织成清晰、易于管理的单元，因此您可以一次学习一个主题。 按照自己的步调在单元中前进 重新温习难点主题 保存最喜欢的单元以便快速复习 筛选收藏夹进行针对性练习 跟踪分数并查看您的历史记录 这创造了一个简单的学习循环：学习、测试、复习和提高。 多种语言 学习和练习以下语言的词汇： 西班牙语 英语 法语 意大利语 日语 荷兰语 葡萄牙语 在应用内随时切换您的目标语言。内容会实时更新，因此您可以在不中断学习的情况下继续练习。 发音支持 内置发音功能有助于将拼写、意义和声音联系起来。在学习的同时聆听单词发音，为阅读、听力和口语打下更坚实的基础。 整洁、现代的设计 界面简单、响应迅速且易于导航。清晰的视觉提示让您的注意力集中在学习上，而流畅的动画和反馈使进步过程充满成就感，且不会分散注意力。 难度随着您词汇量的扩大自然增加，在保持挑战性的同时，帮助您不断建立信心。 专为日常练习打造 Lingo Picture Match 非常适合积累核心词汇的初学者，以及提高准确性和记忆力的中级学习者。 可用于快速的日常复习、专注的学习课程，或作为语言课程的辅助练习。 通过图片学习。双向进行练习。将词汇转化为自信的记忆。 下载 Lingo Picture Match，让语言学习成为一个简单、直观且高效的习惯。

6788763215.name: 演讲镜子 - 智能演讲与口播排练
6788763215.trackName: 演讲镜子 - 智能演讲与口播排练
6788763215.description: 还在因为紧张导致语速失控，或者因为高频口头禅、低头看稿而错失关键机会吗？ 「演讲镜子」是一款依托苹果神经网络引擎（ANE）打造的 100% 设备端本地演讲与口播排练诊断工具。我们拒绝平庸的泛泛而谈，只用硬核的多模态算法，帮您精确定位下一次练习需要改正的 3 个关键问题。 核心优势与功能亮点： 1. 100% 本地运行 (On-Device Security) 无论是商业秘密路演、求职面试准备，还是未公开的演讲草稿，所有语音识别、视觉追踪与逻辑评估均在您的设备本地完成。无需上传任何字节到云端，绝对隐私，离线亦可完美运行。 2. 多模态物理指标精准量化 利用前置镜头和本地麦克风实时解算您的表达姿态： 眼神注视分析：精准监测每一秒您的目光是否游离、有无看着镜头。 低头频次监测：自动捕捉排练中频繁低头看稿的仪态硬伤。 语速与停顿趋势：动态监测 WPM（每分钟字数）起伏，捕捉超过 2 秒的尴尬卡顿。 口头禅捕获器：抓取“然后、那个、呃”等语气词，生成个性化脱水词云。 3. 独创 STAR 故事逻辑框架评估 不用繁琐的云端大模型，本地算法即可自动对您的表达文本进行 STAR（情境 S、任务 T、行动 A、结果 R）四维结构分析，直观展示逻辑脉络，帮您把松散的口播打磨得像大厂高管汇报一样清晰有力。 4. 极速导出 PDF 专业报告 排练结束即刻生成多维度趋势图表、时间轴缺陷高亮和下一遍排练的 3 个矫正对策。支持一键导出完整 PDF 诊断报告，用于团队分享或个人长期存档。 5. 交互式 Mock Q&A 追问练习 模拟真实演讲完后的提问环节，针对您的转写内容本地生成追问题目，打通“说-改-答”极速蜕变的闭环。 纯粹的买断制体验： 我们坚信优秀的高效工具不应以年费订阅来绑架用户。「演讲镜子」一次付费，终身使用，永久解锁全部诊断功能。无任何广告，无后台推送，给您最纯净的专注训练体验。

6446798748.description: 你是否因为录像软件反应缓慢而错过了重要的瞬间？别担心，我们的录像软件为你解决了这个问题！快速的启动时间让你不会错过任何一个瞬间。只需打开应用开始录制，再返回主屏幕就可停止录制。这是记录所有有趣、自然瞬间、让你难以忘怀的完美解决方案！ 不仅如此，我们最新的更新增加了100倍缩放功能，可让你和你的镜头更亲密。此外，我们支持URL方案，让你只需轻点几下，就能轻松快捷地编辑已录制的视频，再也不必费时寻找记录了。我们的应用使你离你的创意杰作仅几步之遥。 更方便的是，我们增加了3D Touch快捷方式，可直接启动应用到录像接口。想切换前后相机？只需使用xFilm://front和xFilm://back URL方案。需要调整设置？使用xFilm://settings URL方案。想查看你的录制视频？只需使用xFilm://videos URL方案。我们的应用将所有力量放在你的手中，更容易地捕捉和分享你的记忆。 但是不要只听我们的话，亲自尝试我们的应用并看看它为你所有的录像需求提供了最佳选择。通过快速启动、缩放支持和URL方案，再也不会错过任何一个瞬间！

6751312171.name: Phase Chimes
6751312171.description: MAKE MUSICAL MACHINES! Link gears together to compose surprisingly complex rhythms and melodies. Runs as an AUv3 MIDI plugin in host apps like AUM and Logic Pro (for iPad), or as a standalone app so you can explore musical ideas on your iPhone or iPad whenever inspiration strikes! THE CONCEPT Differently-sized gears define gear ratios, which produce polyrhythms. The connection angle between gears determines note pitch. Use these simple principles to create generative compositions with a visually elegant user interface. Compose patterns that evolve over time, or perform live by changing and arranging gears on-the-fly. FEATURES Set each gear's size, offset, velocity, duration, and MIDI channel. Store multiple snapshots of your composition and smoothly transition between them. Reposition groups of gears to transpose and re-harmonize multiple notes at the same time. Almost any aspect of a composition can be randomized. Control external software or hardware instruments when in standalone MIDI mode or as an AUv3 plugin. Synchronizes with your DAW's timeline to play in time with other tracks. Get started quickly with an onscreen tutorial and a bunch of factory presets. SOUNDS Select from internal sounds such as a sampled grand piano, a Wurlitzer, and a vintage synthesizer. Whether you want to create a live audio-visual performance, add a polyrhythmic layer to your project, or compose an ambient, meditative atmosphere, Phase Chimes will surprise you with something new every time you engage with it.

6791396893.description: 投资成长日记是一款为个人投资者设计的本地记录与复盘工具。 它不帮你预测行情，也不替你做交易决策，而是帮助你在每一次想买、想卖、焦虑、乐观或 FOMO 时，把当下的情绪和判断写下来。等时间过去，再回头验证：当初的理由是否成立？情绪是否影响了动作？哪些判断值得保留，哪些需要修正？
